_meta._BASIS_AUDIT_ACROSS_ALL_SEVEN_BLOCKS_202: SYSTEMATIC AUDIT RUN AFTER THE KDH ERROR, TO BOUND IT. Every Q1/Q2/H1 numeric field in every ticker block was extracted and every derivable triple re-checked. THE RESULT IS REASSURING AND THE DIAGNOSIS IS SHARPER THAN THE ONE WRITTEN AN HOUR AGO. WHAT RECONCILES: HPG npat 9,056 + 6,424 = 15,480 EXACT. MBB reconciles FOUR WAYS - PBT 9,628 + 10,560 = 20,188; NPAT-to-parent 7,515.52 + 8,229.06 = 15,744.58; TOI 17,430 + 20,434.31 = 37,865; opex 4,347 + 5,627 = 9,974. HPG's core/total bridge also holds: H1 total 15,480 minus the 4,123 Q1 gain gives 11,357, which is what the file states. TCB, VPB, TCX and VPX carry ONLY h1_pbt with no quarterly split, so no derivation was possible and none was made. SO KDH WAS THE ONLY PLACE THE ERROR OCCURRED. The damage is bounded to one ticker. AND THE REAL DIAGNOSIS IS A NAMING CONVENTION, WHICH ONE BLOCK ALREADY DEMONSTRATES. THE KDH FAILURE WAS NOT ARITHMETIC - 327 minus 321 computes fine. It was that q1_npat (CONSOLIDATED) and h1_npat (CORE OR PARENT) CARRY NO BASIS IN THEIR NAMES, so nothing signalled that pairing them was invalid. WORSE, THE TWO HAPPENED TO SIT WITHIN 2% OF EACH OTHER BY COINCIDENCE, so the invalid pairing produced 'Q2 is roughly zero' - a number that is dramatic but coherent, rather than absurd. AN ABSURD RESULT WOULD HAVE BEEN CAUGHT IMMEDIATELY; A PLAUSIBLE ONE SURVIVED TEN DAYS. MBB'S BLOCK IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE AND THE FIX. It carries q1_npat AND q1_npat_parent, q1_pbt AND q1_pbt_parent, h1_npat_parent - THE BASIS IS IN THE FIELD NAME, so a mismatched pairing is visible before it is computed. That convention would have made the KDH error impossible to write. THE ONE LATENT MISMATCH LEFT, ALREADY KNOWN AND HANDLED IN PROSE BUT NOT IN NAMES: HPG's actuals (q1/q2/h1_npat) are TOTAL while fy26e_npat is explicitly CORE, ex the divestment gain. The file states this and does its branch comparison on core, so no error has been made - BUT THE PROTECTION IS A SENTENCE, NOT A FIELD NAME, and the sentence is the thing that fails at 3am. RECOMMENDED TO A HUMAN: rename to the MBB convention across all blocks. That is a schema change and therefore human-only under charter s4.

_meta._AUDIT_FIELD_VERSUS_PROSE_2026_08_06_085:
RAN THE PATTERN AS A TEST INSTEAD OF WAITING TO TRIP OVER IT AGAIN. Four field-versus-prose contradictions were found by accident in twenty-four hours - KDH's Binh Trung Moi date, effective_broker_pct, MBB's provisioning, VPB's credit. THIS SWEEP SEARCHED FOR THEM DELIBERATELY, BY EXTRACTING EVERY CLAIM OF ABSENCE IN assumptions.json AND CHECKING WHETHER THE FILE HOLDS THE THING IT SAYS IT LACKS.

SCALE: 129 CLAIMS OF ABSENCE across the file ('still unknown', 'is not established', 'not on file', 'never recorded', 'still the gap'). FIVE OF THEM ARE CROSS-BLOCK - A CLAIM IN ONE TICKER'S BLOCK ABOUT ANOTHER TICKER'S DATA. THREE OF THOSE FIVE ARE STALE.

FIFTH INSTANCE, AND IT IS THE WORST BECAUSE IT IS LOAD-BEARING. THE TCB BLOCK READS: 'THE GAP, STATED PLAINLY: VPB (10.0%) GREW PBT 68% AND ITS PROVISIONING LINE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. That is the largest unexplained profit jump in the book and the one name where this analysis could not be run.' vpb.actuals HOLDS h1_provisions_bn 15,579, h1_provisions_yoy 0.237, h1_ppop_bn 34,479, h1_provisions_pct_of_ppop 0.452 AND _h1_provisioning_intensity_prior_year 0.528 - ELEVEN RELATED FIELDS. IT WAS RESOLVED ON 02-AUG AT 21:53 AND ITEM 26 ALREADY USES IT ('VPB RESOLVED: provisions ROSE 23.7% to 15,579bn... 23.4pp of its 68% growth is provisioning'). THE TCB NOTE WAS NEVER UPDATED AND STILL CALLS IT THE ONE NAME THE ANALYSIS COULD NOT BE RUN ON.

SIXTH INSTANCE, AND IT IS IN VPB'S OWN BLOCK. The same sentence appears inside vpb.actuals - 'its credit provisioning line is NOT ESTABLISHED' - EIGHT FIELDS AWAY FROM h1_provisions_bn = 15,579. THIS ONE MATTERS BEYOND ITS SIZE BECAUSE IT BREAKS THE COMFORTABLE EXPLANATION. THE FILE'S APPEND-ONLY CONVENTION HANDLES PROSE SUPERSEDING PROSE - a later dated key sits beside the earlier one and a reader meets both. IT HAS NO MECHANISM AT ALL FOR A FIELD SUPERSEDING PROSE. NOTHING IN THIS FILE MAKES A NUMBER CONTRADICT A SENTENCE.

SEVENTH INSTANCE. vpb.actuals: 'VPB has put 1,100bn into a TOKENISED-ASSET EXCHANGE... WHETHER THIS IS THE SAME VENTURE IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT ASSUMED.' RESOLVED AT 20:53 YESTERDAY IN THE VPX BLOCK: CAEX is 11/39/50 and sums to 100, so there is no room for a separate VPB stake, and 11% of 10,000bn is 1,100bn. THE RESOLUTION IS CROSS-BLOCK, SO NOBODY READING vpb WILL FIND IT.

EIGHTH INSTANCE, AND IT IS A DERIVED RATIO RATHER THAN AN ABSENCE CLAIM. THE TCX BLOCK CONTAINS BOTH '2.49x IS UNREPRODUCIBLE and its inputs are not on file. The reproducible figure is 2.075x' AND '2.49x is exact: 41,100 x 2,773,896,000 / filed equity 45,782bn = 2.4902x'. THE 2.075x IS ARITHMETICALLY IDENTIFIED: 41,100 x 2,311,308,021 / 45,782bn = 2.0749 - IT USED THE STALE LISTING-DATE SHARE COUNT, superseded by the 04-Aug verification. Two live claims about the same ratio, 20% apart, on the name the file calls priciest in the book.

WHAT SURVIVES AS LEGITIMATE, BECAUSE NOT EVERY ABSENCE CLAIM IS ROT. The other two cross-block claims are sound: TCX's 'what share of TCBS's arranged volume is Masterise-linked is NOT established' is still true, and VPX's quotation of the VPB note exists in order to resolve it. AND MOST OF THE 129 ARE CORRECT AND VALUABLE - they are the file's refusals to infer, which is its best habit. THE PROBLEM IS NOT THAT THE FILE RECORDS WHAT IT DOES NOT KNOW; IT IS THAT NOTHING RETIRES THOSE RECORDS WHEN THEY STOP BEING TRUE.

THE DIAGNOSIS, SHARPER THAN 'THE FILE HAS CONTRADICTIONS'. THREE FAILURE MODES, IN DESCENDING ORDER OF DANGER. (1) A CLAIM IN BLOCK A ABOUT DATA IN BLOCK B - nobody reading A checks B, and there is no fix inside the append-only convention. THREE OF TODAY'S FOUR ARE THIS SHAPE. (2) A PROSE CLAIM CONTRADICTED BY A PLAIN NUMERIC FIELD IN THE SAME BLOCK - the convention assumes prose is superseded by prose. (3) A DERIVED RATIO OUTLIVING ITS INPUTS - six instances already logged this week, and TCX's 2.075x is the seventh.

NOTHING IS EDITED. Every one of these is prose in a dated entry, and this file does not overwrite dated entries - the practice that made the audit possible is the same practice that lets the staleness accumulate. THE CHEAP RULE THAT WOULD PREVENT MOST OF IT: AN ABSENCE CLAIM ABOUT ANOTHER TICKER SHOULD NAME THE FIELD THAT WOULD RESOLVE IT, so a future reader can test it in one grep instead of trusting it. Recorded as a proposal; conventions are human-only under charter s4.

NOTHING MODELLED. No branch, probability, price, weight or confidence moved.

Charter s5 is explicit: where evidence contradicts a THESIS rather than a number, do not quietly retune - say so and escalate. RAISING CONFIDENCE WOULD HAVE BEEN THE QUIET RETUNE. This is recorded as a deviation so a human can overrule it, and as a note that the routine's rule needs a caveat for the case where branches cannot be revised in the same run.

actuals._FORECAST_ATTRIBUTION_CORRECTED_2026_07_: ATTRIBUTION FIX plus a checkable disagreement, both found hours before the print. Our pre-registered read maps 348bn to ~35 units. Those do not reconcile. Worse, on our own economics 26 units does NOT produce 348bn of parent profit: 26.7 x 42 x 65% margin = 730bn gross, less 94-102bn quarterly opex = ~630bn PBT, x0.79 tax x 51% Gladia stake = ~253-256bn to parent. Roughly 100bn short of the 348bn headline. SO ONE OF THREE THINGS IS TRUE, and the statement decides which: (a) the third house assumes a margin well above our 65%; (b) it assumes revenue is consolidated while profit is parent, or some other entity mismatch; or (c) our 51% Gladia stake / opex solve is wrong. The TIER DOES NOT MOVE - this is still T5 press describing a research note, not the note itself - so no confidence changes on it (charter s2). Its stated reason is negative growth against a high 2025 base, which is coherent with the figure rather than merely compatible with it. (3) CONTEXT ON MBS: its 170bn (-15%) sits inside a house-wide call that most listed developers' Q2 profit FALLS. So MBS is not making a KDH-specific bear call; it is applying a sector view. THE PART THAT MATTERS is not the profit spread but the REVENUE spread underneath it: VCBS 1,123bn against NHSV 350bn is 3.2x, and revenue is close to a direct read on units handed. The houses are not disagreeing about margins or one-offs, they are disagreeing about how many apartments completed. That is precisely the variable calibration forecast #1 resolves on. actuals._53BN_IS_Q1_CORE_NOT_Q2_2026_07_29: PERIOD MISLABEL CAUGHT BEFORE IT WAS LOGGED - the fifth of this class in four days, and the closest to actually landing. A search summary this sweep opened with 'KDH core profit in Q2 2026 reached approximately 53bn, declining 57% YoY, due to Gladia handover delays'. Past tense, a specific number, and it would have read as the Q2 print that resolves calibration forecast #1. IT IS NOT. The same summary's next paragraph says the 53bn is what remains of Q1 after excluding the 285bn extraordinary gain from a real-estate acquisition and the 6 units handed at Gladia - and 285bn and 6 units are unmistakably Q1/2026, both already on file here. The source article is dated 01-Jul, titled 'brokers DIVERGE in Q2 profit FORECASTS'. So the figure is Q1 core, quoted inside a piece about Q2 forecasts, and the summary attached the wrong quarter to it. WHAT IT IS WORTH ANYWAY, as a cross-check on a number we hold. This file derives Q1 core as q1_pbt 355.7 minus q1_bargain_gain 285.2 = 70.5bn, on a PBT basis. The source's 53bn is 75.2% of that, which is close to an after-tax reading but NOT clean: Vietnam CIT is 20%, and 70.5 x 0.80 = 56.4, not 53. The residual is ~3.4bn, or an effective rate of 24.8%. THREE READINGS SURVIVE: the 53bn is core NPAT with a minority-interest deduction; the source strips more from 'core' than just the bargain gain; or the bargain gain is not entirely pre-tax. THIS IS THE SAME SHAPE AS HPG's 113bn gap - a core-plus-one-off that does not quite reconcile to the headline, and in both cases the unresolved item is whether the one-off is pre- or post-tax. NOT RESOLVED, nothing overwritten, and KDH remains UNFILED as of 15:54 ICT 29-Jul.

actuals._q1_revenue_RESOLVED_THE_FIELD_WAS_RIGHT: RESOLVED, AND MY CONCLUSION WAS WRONG. q1_revenue = 281.4 IS CORRECT AND IS REVENUE. A source this sweep states it explicitly and with the matching decimal: KDH recorded NET REVENUE (doanh thu thuan) of approximately 281.4bn in Q1/2026, DOWN 60.4% YoY, while AFTER-TAX PROFIT rose to MORE THAN 327bn, up about 175.5%. So revenue is 281.4 and profit is 327 - two different numbers, and this file had the right one in the right field all along. WHAT I GOT WRONG, AND HOW. Across 28-Jul and 29-Jul I built an increasingly confident case that 281.4 was mislabelled net profit, ending at 'THREE ROUTES NOW AGREE'. All three were weaker than I treated them, and all three trace back to the same ambiguous press phrasing rather than to three independent observations: (1) ARITHMETIC: q1_pbt 355.7 x 0.79 = 281.0. That is NOT 281.4. I treated a near-match as a match. The exact decimal 281.4 appearing in a source that calls it doanh thu thuan is decisive against it. (2) THE GROWTH RATE: I argued '+131% attaches to 281 wherever it appears'. The growth rate actually attaching to Q1 PROFIT is +175.5%, on a base of 327 - a different rate on a different number. (3) THE 'DECLINING REVENUE' CLAUSE, which I called decisive on 29-Jul. The source said revenue DECLINED and mentioned 281 in the same breath. Revenue declined TO 281.4. I read it as 'revenue declined, and separately profit was 281'. THE CLAUSE MEANT THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT I TOOK IT TO MEAN. THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT ON FILE WAS RIGHT AND I DISMISSED IT. The original note said 6 units at an ASP of 42-44bn implies revenue of 252-264bn, 'close enough to 281.4 that a genuine revenue figure is not impossible'. That reconciles well - revenue slightly above unit sales, consistent with other revenue lines. I let three weak confirmations override one sound arithmetic check. THE LESSON, and it is not the period/entity/measure one: THREE ROUTES THAT ALL TRACE TO THE SAME AMBIGUOUS SOURCE PHRASING ARE ONE ROUTE COUNTED THREE TIMES. Independence has to be checked, not assumed, and the count of confirmations is not the strength of the evidence. WHAT IT RESTORES. The 28-Jul note claimed the pre-registered Q2 read had lost its second verification route because 'we do not have a revenue figure at all'. WE DO. The revenue route exists and is available for today's print. dossiers/KDH.md section 3 instructs checking the Q2 units count from BOTH the Gladia inventory movement AND the revenue line - both are live. ALSO ADDED: q1_npat 327 (new field, was never recorded) and q1_revenue_yoy -0.604. Note PBT 355.7 against NPAT 327 implies tax of 28.7bn, an 8.1% effective rate - low, and consistent with a largely non-taxable bargain-purchase gain, but not exactly reproducible. Flagged, not resolved. OPEN-DECISIONS item 14 is now ANSWERED: the field is revenue, no change needed.

actuals._770BN_REJECTION_WAS_TOO_STRONG_2026_07_: CORRECTION TO MY OWN ENTRY FROM ONE HOUR AGO. At 17:53 I wrote that the reported Q2 net profit of ~770bn was 'internally impossible' and rejected it. THAT WAS OVERSTATED. It is irreconcilable with H1 net profit of 321bn ON A SINGLE MEASURE BASIS - but the two figures may simply be on DIFFERENT BASES, and that possibility is not eliminated. THE RECONCILING READING, which I cannot rule out: 'loi nhuan sau thue' (total NPAT, including minority interests) of ~770bn in Q2, against 'lai rong' (NPAT attributable to parent) of 321bn for H1. KDH FULLY CONSOLIDATES JVs IT DOES NOT WHOLLY OWN - the file records a 51% Gladia stake - so minority interests are material. Q1 parent ~327 and H1 parent 321 gives Q2 PARENT of about -6bn, which is CONSISTENT with a Q2 TOTAL of +770bn if roughly 776bn accrued to minorities. That is a large minority share, and it is unusual, but a deconsolidation can produce exactly that shape. SO THE HONEST STATUS IS: EITHER ONE FIGURE IS WRONG OR THEY ARE DIFFERENT MEASURES. Not resolved. The separate statement will settle it. What I should have written an hour ago is that the two do not reconcile on one basis - not that one of them is impossible. THIS IS THE SAME ERROR SHAPE AS THIS MORNING'S q1_revenue MISTAKE, twelve hours apart: treating an apparent contradiction as settled when a MEASURE DIFFERENCE could explain it. There I forced two numbers to be the same thing; here I forced them to be incompatible. Both are the same failure to hold 'these may be different quantities' open. WHAT IS NEW AND NOT IN DOUBT, and it strengthens rather than weakens the thesis: THE PROFIT IS ONE-OFF DRIVEN, NOT OPERATIONAL. Press covering the filing states that most of KDH's H1 profit came from ONE-TIME INCOME rather than from selling and handing over property. The Q2 item named is the disposal of a 2% interest in BINH TRUNG MOI REAL ESTATE on 23-JUN-2026 for over 68bn. Q1's was the 285bn An Lap bargain-purchase gain. TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS WHERE THE HEADLINE PROFIT COMES FROM TRANSACTIONS RATHER THAN FROM THE BUSINESS, while revenue fell 75% across the half. NOTE the 68bn disposal cannot by itself explain a 770bn profit swing, which is a further reason the 770bn figure needs the statement rather than the press.
actuals._ASP_THE_LISTING_SITE_ROUTE_FAILS_AND_IS: OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 15 (ASP 42 vs 44bn) WAS ATTEMPTED VIA PROJECT PRICE PAGES AND THE ROUTE FAILS. RECORDED AS A DISARMED TRAP RATHER THAN AS EVIDENCE, because the numbers it returns are attractive, easy to find, and would badly corrupt a load-bearing input. WHAT THE ROUTE RETURNS: broker and agency pages quoting Gladia at '15 ty/can' (June 2026) and low-rise product 'from 230 trieu/m2' (July 2026). WHY NEITHER IS USABLE. (1) SOURCE: these are AGENCY MARKETING PAGES, not company disclosure - below T6 on the charter's ladder, and written by parties whose incentive is to quote an attractive entry price. Charter s2 permits T6 to raise confidence not at all; this is weaker still. (2) MEASURE: '15 ty/can' is a headline or STARTING price for the cheapest product, not a realised ASP across a handover mix. (3) THE TWO QUOTES CONTRADICT EACH OTHER: at 230m/m2, a 250-300m2 villa is 57-69bn, four times the same site's own '15 ty/can'. A source that disagrees with itself by 4x cannot settle a 4.8% question. AND THE FILE'S OWN ARITHMETIC ALREADY REFUTES THE 15bn. Q1 revenue of ~252-264bn on 6 UNITS HANDED gives 42-44bn per unit directly, which is where the on-file figure comes from. If ASP were 15bn, six handovers would have produced ~90bn, not ~252-264bn. THE INTERNAL CHECK KILLS IT WITHOUT NEEDING AN EXTERNAL SOURCE, which is the cheapest kind of refutation and the one to reach for first. WHAT LOGGING IT WOULD HAVE COST: ASP is the denominator that converts KDH revenue into UNIT COUNTS, and the unit count is the whole basis of the dossier's bull-infeasibility finding (bull needs ~178-186 units against a 135-unit sold book). Substituting 15bn would have inflated implied unit counts by ~2.9x and made the bull case look impossible FOR A FABRICATED REASON - a right conclusion reached through a wrong number, which the calibration log already records as a failure mode. ITEM 15 STAYS OPEN. It is settled by the segment note in KDH's own financial statements - revenue by project divided by units delivered - not by any price list. SAME SPECIES AS THE HRC BENCHMARK TRAP: right name, wrong basis, and the wrong one is the one a search finds first.
actuals._ESCALATION_TRIGGER_5_VNDIAMOND_EFFECTIV: ESCALATION - TRIGGER 5 FIRES. DECISION-FRAMEWORK s4 test 5 is 'a dated catalyst lands within 5 sessions of a proposed trade in that name'. KDH carries a proposed TRIM of -4.7pp and is 20.3% of the book. THE VNDIAMOND REVIEW RESULTS WERE ANNOUNCED 20-JULY-2026 AND THE CHANGES TAKE EFFECT 03-AUGUST-2026, WHICH IS MONDAY - THE NEXT TRADING SESSION. WHY KDH IS EXPOSED: it was placed on the removal watch list for failing VNDiamond's MINIMUM FOREIGN OWNERSHIP LIMIT TEST OF 65%, SITTING AT 61.8%, and the decisive review is the SEMI-ANNUAL one held in JULY - which CORRECTS what this file wrote at 19:53. That entry said 'reviews are quarterly, so a Q3 review falls around July'. The timing was right by accident; the mechanism was not. VNDIAMOND REBALANCES QUARTERLY BUT REVIEWS CONSTITUENTS SEMI-ANNUALLY, and removal happens at the semi-annual review. Sources state KDH 'may be officially removed at the next semi-annual review in July 2026 if there is no improvement above the 65% mark'. WHETHER IT WAS ACTUALLY REMOVED IS STILL NOT ESTABLISHED. The 20-July announcement itself was not found this sweep. THAT IS THE WHOLE QUESTION AND IT IS NOT GUESSED. AND THE FLOW HAS PROBABLY ALREADY HAPPENED, WHICH CHANGES WHAT THE HUMAN SHOULD BE ASKING. On 31-JUL this file established, and corrected its own escalation over, the mechanic that INDEX FUNDS TRADE AT THE CLOSE OF THE SESSION BEFORE AN EFFECTIVE DATE, NOT ON IT - that is why the VN30 ETFs completed their rebalance on 31-Jul for a 03-Aug effective date. THE SAME MECHANIC APPLIES HERE. If KDH was removed on 20-Jul, the ETF selling would have completed AT FRIDAY 31-JULY'S CLOSE, and Monday's effective date is administrative. SO THE QUESTION IS NOT 'WHAT HAPPENS MONDAY', IT IS 'DID IT ALREADY HAPPEN ON FRIDAY, AND DOES THE FILE'S KDH PRICE REFLECT IT'. That runs straight into OPEN-DECISIONS item 2: prices are undated and presumed 24-Jul. Friday 31-Jul saw VN-Index -8.9 points, foreign net selling of 307bn and roughly 200 decliners - THIS FILE DOES NOT KNOW WHETHER KDH WAS AMONG THEM. SIZE, WITH THE GAP STATED: KDH's VNDiamond weight is NOT KNOWN, so the removal flow cannot be sized against the ~12,486bn tracking pool. TCB's 9.0% weight is ~1,124bn for scale. NOTHING MODELLED, no weight, branch or probability touched. ALSO CONFIRMED, and it shows the door swings both ways: MWG RETURNED to VNDiamond after half a year out, so removal is not permanent.
actuals._THE_VNDIAMOND_FLOW_IS_SIZED_AND_MY_OWN_: SIZED, AND THE FIRST THING TO SAY IS THAT MY OWN ILLUSTRATIONS TWO SWEEPS AGO WERE BADLY TOO HIGH. At 19:53, unable to find KDH's index weight, this file offered '3/5/7% would be 375/624/874bn of forced selling' and labelled them illustrations rather than estimates. THE ACTUAL FIGURE IS ABOUT 72bn - BETWEEN FIVE AND TWELVE TIMES SMALLER THAN THE RANGE ILLUSTRATED. The label was correct and the numbers were still misleading, because a reader takes the magnitude from the digits and not from the caveat. OFFERING AN ILLUSTRATIVE RANGE WHEN THE REAL NUMBER IS UNKNOWN ANCHORS THE READER AT WHATEVER THE ILLUSTRATION HAPPENS TO BE. Better to have written 'weight unknown, cannot be sized' and stopped. THE FIGURE: ETFs are expected to sell OVER 4 MILLION KDH SHARES to remove it from the portfolio. At the file's 18,000 price that is ~72bn, which is 0.40% OF KDH'S ~18,010bn IMPLIED MARKET CAP. For comparison the TCX VN30 entry was 59bn on an 82,215bn cap, or 0.073% - so IN RELATIVE TERMS KDH'S REMOVAL IS ABOUT 5.5x THE TCX EVENT, and in absolute terms the two are similar. KDH is named among the largest selling pressures alongside NLG AND MSB. AND THE CAUSE CLOSES A LOOP THIS FILE HAD BOTH HALVES OF. The sources are explicit that KDH DID NOT CHANGE ITS FOREIGN OWNERSHIP LIMIT - the adjusted FOL fell because FOREIGN INVESTORS REDUCED THEIR HOLDINGS OVER THE PAST TWELVE MONTHS. This file recorded on 30-Jul that VINACAPITAL HAS BEEN SELLING KDH DOWN THROUGH THE 7% THRESHOLD to 6.9621%, and treated that as an ownership signal pointing the opposite way to the insider buy. IT IS ALSO A MECHANICAL CAUSE: foreign selling lowers the FOL ratio, a low FOL ratio triggers index removal, and index removal forces further selling. STATED PROPORTIONATELY - VinaCapital's disclosed steps are April-May and the FOL decline is described over twelve months, so VinaCapital is ONE CONTRIBUTOR, NOT THE CAUSE. The loop is real; the attribution is partial. STILL NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the 20-July announcement actually removed KDH. The '4 million shares' is a FORECAST of ETF selling, and search returns keep mixing the Q2 review (cutoff 31-Mar, announced 20-Apr, effective 04-May) with the July one (announced 20-Jul, effective 03-Aug). The two follow the same announce-then-effective-two-weeks-later pattern, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY THEY ARE EASY TO CONFLATE. The trigger-5 escalation stands on the date, not on a confirmed removal.
actuals._KDH_ABSENT_FROM_FRIDAYS_SELL_LIST_AND_W: LOOKED FOR THE FOOTPRINT OF THE VNDIAMOND REMOVAL INSTEAD OF THE ANNOUNCEMENT, AFTER THREE FAILED ATTEMPTS AT THE ANNOUNCEMENT ITSELF. KDH DOES NOT APPEAR AMONG THE LARGEST FOREIGN NET SELLS ON 31-JUL; that list is VHM, TCB, VPB, NVL and ACB. AND I WAS PROBABLY LOOKING IN THE WRONG COLUMN, WHICH IS THE USEFUL PART. THE VNDIAMOND ETFs ARE DOMESTIC FUNDS - DCVFMVN Diamond (Dragon Capital), MAFM, KIM Growth, VFCVN (TPBank). Their rebalancing trades are DOMESTIC INSTITUTIONAL FLOW and need not appear in the FOREIGN net-sell column at all. The picture is genuinely ambiguous, because foreign investors are the main HOLDERS of these ETFs - that is their purpose, accessing FOL-capped stocks - so redemptions could surface as foreign flow. EITHER WAY, ABSENCE FROM A FOREIGN TOP-FIVE IS WEAK EVIDENCE ABOUT A DOMESTIC ETF REBALANCE. SIZE ALSO ARGUES FOR CAUTION: the estimated removal flow is ~72bn against VHM's 249bn on the HOSE measure, so KDH could have been sold in full and still missed a top-five list. THE HONEST CONCLUSION IS THAT THIS SWEEP DID NOT ANSWER THE QUESTION, and the negative result is recorded so the next sweep does not spend budget re-running it. THE ANSWER NEEDS EITHER THE 20-JULY HOSE ANNOUNCEMENT OR KDH'S TRADING-VOLUME SERIES FOR 31-JUL, NEITHER OF WHICH THIS ENVIRONMENT HAS REACHED. ONE FIGURE CONFIRMED IN PASSING: KDH's 2026 AGM profit target of 1,500bn matches company_plan_npat already on file exactly, alongside 'clean of bond debt' and an explicit commitment to NO NEW EQUITY ISSUANCE. The last of those is worth having beside the VNDiamond problem - a company that has ruled out issuing equity has one fewer lever for raising its foreign-ownership ratio.

actuals._A_THIRD_Q2_PROFIT_FIGURE_AND_IT_REOPENS: MATERIAL CONFLICT ON 20.3% OF THE BOOK, FLAGGED AND DELIBERATELY NOT RESOLVED. Keppel 49% / KDH 51%, agreed May-2023, both in Thu Duc, construction from Oct-2023. 'Clarita divestment' is a named lane-3 item and every prior hit on Clarita in this repo was MY OWN MENTION FROM THIS WEEKEND, not research. THIS IS THE THIRD MULTI-SOURCE NUMERIC CONFLICT ON KDH IN TEN DAYS - q1_revenue (281.4, three sweeps to resolve), the 770bn Q2 figure, and now this. KDH IS THE SINGLE LARGEST SOURCE OF NUMERIC AMBIGUITY IN THE BOOK, and it is the second-largest position with a live trigger-5 escalation. actuals._ESCALATION_THE_H1_NPAT_ON_FILE_IS_WRONG: ESCALATION. h1_npat = 321 IS WRONG AS A CONSOLIDATED FIGURE, AND THE ERROR PROPAGATED INTO A SCORED CALIBRATION ENTRY AND AN ESCALATION. RESOLVED THIS SWEEP FROM MULTIPLE SOURCES: KDH's Q2/2026 NPAT IS 770bn. H1 IS ~1,095bn, WHICH IS 73% OF THE 1,500bn FULL-YEAR TARGET. The file's own q1_npat of 327 reconciles it exactly: 327 + 770 = 1,097 against the stated ~1,095. THE DRIVER IS FINANCIAL INCOME OF MORE THAN 906bn, arising largely from THE TRANSFER OF 51% OF BINH TRUNG MOI - and core property operations did collapse, which is why one source reads 'core business plunges, KDH still reports profit up four times'. BOTH HALVES ARE TRUE AND THIS FILE ONLY EVER HAD ONE. WHAT THIS CORRECTS, IN ORDER OF SEVERITY. (1) The 30-Jul entry derived 'Q2 PROFIT IS APPROXIMATELY ZERO' from H1 321 minus Q1 327. THAT DERIVATION IS WRONG BECAUSE ITS INPUT WAS WRONG. (2) The same entry called a reported 770bn Q2 profit 'INTERNALLY IMPOSSIBLE'. IT IS THE CORRECT FIGURE. I withdrew that twice - partially on 30-Jul, and again an hour ago as 'right in form and under-done in force'. IT IS NOW FULLY WITHDRAWN: the number I dismissed was simply right. (3) LAST HOUR I WROTE that a Q3 completion should not produce a Q2 gain, and used that to argue the divestment was NOT the explanation. THE DECONSOLIDATION GAIN LANDED IN Q2 FINANCIAL INCOME; the Q3 date refers to full completion. That reasoning was wrong too. WHAT 321 PROBABLY IS: core or ex-gain profit, or a parent-only figure. NOT ESTABLISHED, and it is NOT OVERWRITTEN - charter s5 forbids quietly retuning a number when the measure is unresolved, and this block now holds both figures with their bases labelled so git log stays a truthful record. THE CALIBRATION CONSEQUENCE IS THE PART A HUMAN MUST TAKE. Forecast #1 was 'Q2 PARENT NPAT between 170 and 348bn' and was scored a MISS on the reasoning that Q2 profit was roughly zero. THE FORECAST IS ON PARENT NPAT AND THE 770bn IS CONSOLIDATED, SO I CANNOT RESCORE IT - the parent split is still unknown. BUT THE STATED BASIS FOR THE MISS IS GONE. I am not rescoring it myself: rescoring a forecast on a measure I do not have, in the direction that improves my record, is precisely what the log warns against. FLAGGED FOR A HUMAN. AND THE PORTFOLIO PICTURE CHANGES SHAPE. This file recorded KDH as the quarter's disaster - Q2 revenue -85%, profit near zero, every branch contradicted, every street estimate too high. THE REALITY IS A COLLAPSED CORE BUSINESS AND 73% OF THE FULL-YEAR PLAN DELIVERED AT THE HALF, ON A ONE-OFF. That is a different company from the one in the file: worse operationally than the plan implies, and far better against the plan than the file records. The fy26e_npat branches (1,033/1,590/2,203) need re-deriving against an H1 of ~1,097 that is 73% one-off - HUMAN-ONLY under charter s4.
actuals._TWO_FOREIGN_FUNDS_SELLING_NOT_ONE_AND_O: THE FILE HAD ONE FOREIGN SELLER ON RECORD. THERE ARE TWO. DRAGON CAPITAL'S STAKE IN KDH HAS FALLEN FROM OVER 9% TO 5.9591% AS AT JUNE 2026 - A DROP OF MORE THAN 3 PERCENTAGE POINTS, LARGER THAN VINACAPITAL'S. Nothing on Dragon Capital was in this file. VinaCapital's fall through the 7% threshold to 6.9621% was logged on 30-Jul and treated as the ownership signal; IT WAS THE SMALLER HALF OF THE STORY. Foreign organisations and individuals held NEARLY 38% at an earlier point. AND THE STRUCTURE IS WORTH RECORDING PLAINLY, WITH NO IMPLICATION ATTACHED. DRAGON CAPITAL MANAGES DCVFMVN DIAMOND (FUEVFVND), THE 12,070bn VNDIAMOND ETF logged yesterday - the largest of the four. So the same house is BOTH a large active seller of KDH AND the manager of the index fund that would be forced to sell KDH on removal. THESE ARE DIFFERENT VEHICLES WITH DIFFERENT MANDATES: an active fund reducing a position is an investment decision, an ETF's holding is mechanical index tracking, and NOTHING IMPROPER IS IMPLIED OR EVIDENCED. It is recorded because the mechanism compounds - foreign selling lowers the FOL ratio, a low FOL ratio triggers index removal, and removal forces the ETF to sell - and one house happens to sit at both ends of that chain. THE GAP TO REQUALIFICATION IS SMALLER THAN THE NARRATIVE SUGGESTS. IF the foreign ownership limit is 49% - STANDARD FOR VIETNAMESE REAL ESTATE BUT NOT VERIFIED FOR KDH, AND STATED AS AN ASSUMPTION - then an FOL ratio of 61.8% means actual foreign ownership near 30.3%, and the 65% test requires about 31.9%. THAT IS A GAP OF ROUGHLY 1.6 PERCENTAGE POINTS OF SHARES, or about 282bn of net foreign buying at an 18,010bn market cap. THE CONDITION THAT PUSHED KDH OUT COULD REVERSE ABOUT AS EASILY AS IT AROSE, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF HOW A REMOVAL WATCHLIST READS. MWG's return to the index after half a year out is the precedent already on file. STATED WITH ITS DEPENDENCY: the whole calculation rests on the 49% assumption, and if KDH's limit differs the percentages move proportionally. THE ORDER OF MAGNITUDE - low single-digit percentage points - SURVIVES ANY PLAUSIBLE LIMIT. Nothing modelled; no weight, branch or probability touched.
actuals._CAP_NOW_CROSS_CHECK_KDH_FIRES_TRIGGER_3: KDH IS 20.3% OF THE BOOK AND WAS ONE OF THE TWO NAMES THE 11:53 SWEEP LEFT UNCHECKED. IT FIRES. cap_now = 19.2 x 938 = 18,010bn, implying 1,000.5m shares at the file's 18,000 price. THE SHARE COUNT IS HIGHER ON EVERY READING. RESOLVED PARTLY BY ARITHMETIC, INCLUDING A SOURCE TYPO: one source says the Nov-2024 issuance took charter capital 'from 9,904bn to over 10,111bn, a rise of 2%', which is self-contradictory - 90.9m dividend shares plus 10.8m ESOP shares is 1,017bn of par value, i.e. +10.3%, not +2%. 9,904 + 1,017 = 10,921, which is not 10,111. BUT 9,094 + 1,017 = 10,111 EXACTLY, so the pre-issuance figure is 9,094bn (909.4m shares) and '9,904' is a digit transposition. That also explains the 'over 909 million shares' figure circulating alongside a 1.12bn one - it is the PRE-dividend count. SO THE CONFIRMED FLOOR IS 1,011.1m SHARES (charter 10,111bn) as of Nov-2024, already above the file's implied 1,000.5m. THE LIKELY CURRENT FIGURE IS 1,122.1m. KDH planned 111m shares for 2025 - 101m stock dividend plus 9.96m ESOP at 14,000 - scheduled Q3-Q4 2025. 1,011.1m + 111m = 1,122.1m, AND A SEPARATE SOURCE REPORTS 1.12bn SHARES OUTSTANDING 'after the 2025 dividend/ESOP'. Two independent routes agree. THE TWO READINGS AND WHAT EACH DOES: at the confirmed FLOOR of 1,011.1m, cap_now is 1.0% low and mu_raw goes +16.1% -> +14.9%, a 1.2pp move that fires NOTHING. At the LIKELY 1,122.1m, cap_now is 10.8% low and mu_raw goes +16.1% -> +3.5%, A 12.6pp MOVE THAT FIRES TRIGGER 3. STATED WITH ITS WEAKNESS: the 111m issuance is evidenced as a PLAN with a Q3-Q4 2025 window, not as a completion notice, and this file has been burned before on treating planned as executed. What raises it above a guess is that the plan's arithmetic lands exactly on an independently reported outstanding count, and that the window closed eight months ago. THE TRIGGER IS THEREFORE RECORDED AS FIRING ON THE LIKELY READING AND NOT AS ESTABLISHED BEYOND DOUBT - one completion notice settles it. NOTHING RETUNED; confidence not moved, for the same reason as every other name in this audit. SECOND-ORDER CORRECTION: the 08:53 entry sized KDH's requalification gap as '~1.6 percentage points, or about 282bn of net foreign buying' AGAINST THE 18,010bn cap_now market cap. On the likely 20,197bn cap that figure is ~323bn. The conclusion it supported - that the gap is small and could reverse - is unchanged and if anything the correction is immaterial to it, but the number was stated precisely and is restated here.
actuals._THE_SHARE_COUNT_IS_NOW_CORROBORATED_AND: UPGRADES THE 12:53 FINDING FROM 'LIKELY' TO CORROBORATED BY AN INDEPENDENT PRIMARY ROUTE, ON A 20.3% POSITION AND A FIRED TRIGGER. At 12:53 on 02-Aug I set KDH's share count to 1,122,060,000 - built from charter capital 10,111bn (Nov-2024, confirmed) plus the 111m-share 2025 issue (101m stock dividend + 9.96m ESOP) - and recorded explicitly that the 2025 issue was evidenced as a PLAN WITH A CLOSED WINDOW, NOT A COMPLETION NOTICE, saying 'one completion notice settles it'. NO SEARCH WAS NEEDED. THE SETTLEMENT WAS ALREADY IN THIS FILE. THE INSIDER DISCLOSURE ON FILE STATES THAT LY TUAN KIET GOES FROM 0.056% TO 1.838% BY BUYING 20,000,000 SHARES. A COMPANY COMPUTES THOSE PERCENTAGES AGAINST ITS OWN ACTUAL OUTSTANDING COUNT, SO THE PAIR IS A SHARE COUNT IN DISGUISE. 20,000,000 / (0.01838 - 0.00056) = 1,122,334,456. AGAINST MY DERIVED 1,122,060,000 THAT AGREES TO 0.024%. AND IT REJECTS BOTH ALTERNATIVES, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES IT PROOF RATHER THAN COINCIDENCE. On the pre-2025-issue count of 1,011.1m, 20m shares would be 1.978pp, not the filed 1.782pp. On the count the file's old cap_now implied (1,000.5m) it would be 1.999pp. BOTH ARE OUT BY ROUGHLY 0.2pp, FAR BEYOND ROUNDING. THE 2025 ISSUE EXECUTED. WHAT THIS FIRMS UP. KDH's cap_now correction and its TRIGGER 3 FIRING (mu_raw +16.1% -> +3.5%, a 12.6pp move) rested on the 1,122.1m count; that count is now corroborated two independent ways - charter-capital arithmetic and a company-filed percentage pair. The 12:53 caveat is DISCHARGED. THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: THE DATA WAS IN THE FILE THE WHOLE TIME. The 0.056% -> 1.838% pair has sat in the date-gate table for days, described as 'a thirty-three-fold stake increase' and used only as a signal about INSIDER CONVICTION. Nobody divided it. This is the same defect as pe_ttm x npat_ttm - a quantity recoverable from figures already held, never recovered because no routine looked. NOTHING MODELLED; no input or confidence moved, because the number it confirms is already the number in use.

actuals._THE_UNDATED_LEAD_IS_DATED_AND_IT_IS_A_L: DATED THE LEAD FLAGGED ONE HOUR AGO AS 'for the next sweep to date'. IT IS REAL, IT IS SPECIFIC, AND IT IS ABSENT FROM THIS REPO. GOVERNMENT INSPECTORATE CONCLUSION NO. 46/KL-TTCP, DATED 06-FEBRUARY-2026, on compliance in private corporate-bond issuance and management of bond proceeds. WHAT IT FOUND AT KDH: (1) BOND PROCEEDS USED TO REPAY DEBT rather than to increase working capital as stated in the approved issuance plan and the public disclosure - use of proceeds contrary to stated purpose, reported at OVER 100bn; (2) OFFERING DOCUMENTS NOT ACCURATE, TRUTHFUL AND VERIFIABLE and capable of misleading investors; (3) LATE DISCLOSURE. AND HOW IT ENDED, WHICH MUST BE STATED WITH EQUAL PROMINENCE: NO ADMINISTRATIVE PENALTY WAS IMPOSED. The violations were TIME-BARRED under article 6.1(d) of the Law on Handling of Administrative Violations, so UBCKNN issued no penalty decision. KDH was required to implement the inspection conclusion and comply going forward. THE STATUTE POINT CUTS BOTH WAYS AND BOTH SIDES BELONG IN THE FILE. Time-barred means THE CONDUCT IS OLD - almost certainly the 2021-22 private-placement wave - so THIS IS NOT EVIDENCE ABOUT CURRENT CONDUCT, and KDH's own AGM describes the company as BOND-DEBT FREE today. It also means the finding was never tested in a penalty proceeding. WHAT IT IS NOT is a live enforcement risk. WHAT IT IS is a documented regulatory finding that this company's offering documents were not accurate and its proceeds were not used as disclosed. PROPORTION, SO THIS IS NOT OVERSTATED: 100bn IS SMALL IN MONEY TERMS against inventory above 23,000bn and H1 borrowings up 6,500bn. THE SIGNIFICANCE IS THE CONDUCT, NOT THE AMOUNT. WHY IT BELONGS ON FILE ANYWAY. run.py's own footer states that LAYER 4 ITEMS - governance, quota politics, an An Lap-style related-party surprise - ARE NOT IN THESE NUMBERS. The KDH dossier already carries that An Lap concern as a hypothetical. THIS IS THE SAME FAMILY, DOCUMENTED BY A GOVERNMENT INSPECTORATE RATHER THAN INFERRED, ON THE SECOND-LARGEST POSITION AT 20.3%. A file that prices KDH off KDH's own disclosures should record that a state inspection found those disclosures wanting, even in a period now closed. CONFIDENCE HELD AT 0.55, AND THE ARGUMENT FOR CUTTING IT IS STATED RATHER THAN SUPPRESSED. The case for cutting: most KDH inputs originate in KDH's own disclosures, and a regulator has found those disclosures inaccurate in an earlier period, which is an evidence-quality argument rather than a sentiment one. The case against, which prevails here: the conduct is time-barred and pre-dates every figure in this model; no penalty was imposed; and using the scalar to express a governance opinion is exactly the misuse argued against repeatedly today - confidence multiplies fy26e_npat and cannot encode 'this management once misdescribed a bond'. ESCALATED AS A HUMAN JUDGMENT, NOT APPLIED. NOTHING MODELLED. NO LINK IS DRAWN to the TCB/TCBS Masterise-registrar finding of 18:53. Both concern the Vietnamese property-bond complex and there the resemblance ends; nothing connects them and inventing a connection would be the convenient-inference failure this file has refused twice today.
actuals._THE_Q2_ONE_OFFS_EXCEED_THE_ENTIRE_Q2_PR: THE COMPOSITION OF KDH'S Q2 PROFIT IS NOW ITEMISED, AND IT IS SHARPER THAN 'H1 IS 73% ONE-OFF'. Q2/2026 PROFIT INCLUDED APPROXIMATELY 22bn FROM THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN TRANSFER PRICE AND NET ASSET BOOK VALUE, PLUS NEARLY 875bn RELATED TO CAPITAL TRANSFER TRANSACTIONS. THAT IS 897bn OF IDENTIFIED ONE-OFFS AGAINST A Q2 NPAT OF 770bn - THE ONE-OFFS ARE 116% OF THE QUARTER'S ENTIRE PROFIT. BASIS CAVEAT, STATED BEFORE THE CONCLUSION BECAUSE IT CHANGES ITS SIZE. It is NOT established whether the 875bn and 22bn are PRE-TAX or POST-TAX, while the 770bn NPAT is post-tax. IF THEY ARE PRE-TAX, they convert to about 718bn at a 20% rate and leave roughly 52bn of Q2 profit from everything else. IF THEY ARE POST-TAX, the residual is NEGATIVE at about -127bn. EITHER WAY THE UNDERLYING BUSINESS CONTRIBUTED BETWEEN A TRIVIAL AMOUNT AND A LOSS, and the range between those two readings is the entire operating result. Do not state the -127bn as the finding; state the range. IT ALSO RECONCILES WITH WHAT WAS ALREADY ON FILE. q2_financial_income is 906bn, against 897bn of itemised one-offs - a 1% difference, so THE FINANCIAL-INCOME LINE AND THE ONE-OFF ITEMS ARE THE SAME MONEY seen two ways. That corroborates both figures and closes a loop the file had left open. AND THE BALANCE SHEET MOVES THE OTHER WAY FROM THE INCOME STATEMENT. TOTAL ASSETS 39,471bn AT 30-JUN, UP 16% FROM END-2025. INVENTORY 29,488bn, UP 27% YTD - the file previously carried 'inventory above 23,000bn', so this is BOTH an update and a much larger number. INVENTORY UP 27% WHILE H1 REVENUE FELL 75% (442bn against 1,759bn in H1/2025). The company is accumulating unsold product at an accelerating rate while its sales line collapses, and funding it with the 6,500bn of additional borrowing already on file. THAT IS THE OPERATING PICTURE THE ONE-OFF GAINS ARE MASKING. NEW BASES RECORDED: H1/2025 revenue 1,759bn and Q2/2025 NPAT ~196bn (from the +293% growth on 770bn), neither previously on file. NO REVIEWED STATEMENT YET. The 14-AUG standalone/parent deadline logged this morning stands, and it remains the document that settles the 321 vs 1,097 basis question. CONFIDENCE HELD AT 0.55: this sharpens a picture the file already had - core collapse masked by one-offs - rather than changing an input, and KDH's branches need re-derivation (item 4), which a scalar cannot substitute for. NOTHING MODELLED.
actuals._GLADIA_HEIGHTS_LAUNCHED_AND_THE_DEVELOP:
THE PRECONDITION OF AN ARMED KILL CRITERION IS NOW SATISFIED, AND THE DEVELOPER HAS PUT THE PROFIT IN THE WRONG YEAR FOR THIS MODEL.

THE EVENT, 01-AUGUST-2026. Keppel and KDH launched GLADIA HEIGHTS - about 500 apartments across two towers. MORE THAN 90% WERE BOOKED AT THE LAUNCH EVENT, TOTAL TRANSACTION VALUE NEARLY 4,000bn. HANDOVER EXPECTED DECEMBER 2026 OR JUNE 2027 depending on payment method and sub-zone. THE DEVELOPER EXPECTS TOTAL REVENUE OF ABOUT 6,000bn AND PROFIT OF ABOUT 2,000bn, 'TO BE RECOGNISED IN 2027 AFTER HANDOVER IS COMPLETED'. Interest-rate support of up to 24 months is offered to buyers.

WHY THIS IS THE SHARPEST KDH FINDING SINCE THE Q2 PRINT. run.py section 2 calls this name 'the whole 2026 P&L is one variable' and the variable is the Gladia handover. THE LARGEST COMMERCIAL EVENT OF KDH'S YEAR HAS JUST BEEN PLACED, BY THE DEVELOPER, OUTSIDE THE YEAR THE MODEL IS ABOUT.

THE H2 ARITHMETIC, WHICH STANDS WHATEVER THE BRANCHES ASSUME. H1/2026 consolidated NPAT is 1,097bn. AGAINST fy26e_npat: BASE 1,590 NEEDS 493bn MORE IN H2; BULL 2,203 NEEDS 1,106bn. actuals._THE_896BN_MECHANISM_AND_THE_CRITERION_C: THE MECHANISM BEHIND KDH'S RECORD QUARTER, WHICH THIS FILE NEVER HELD - '896' appeared nowhere in assumptions.json before this entry. KDH completed the transfer of 2% OF CONG TY TNHH BAT DONG SAN BINH TRUNG MOI ON 23-JUN-2026 FOR JUST OVER VND 68bn - AND RECOGNISED OVER VND 896bn OF FINANCIAL REVENUE FROM THAT TRANSACTION. A VND 68bn disposal cannot produce a VND 896bn gain: this is a REMEASUREMENT OF THE RETAINED STAKE ON LOSS OF CONTROL, not a profit on the 2%. That mechanism is my reading of the accounting, NOT a stated one. THE COLLISION. The armed criterion reads 'Earnings quality stays synthetic - a second consecutive quarter where bargain-purchase or revaluation gains exceed operating PBT.' Q1 IS UNAMBIGUOUS AND ON FILE: q1_pbt 355.7, q1_bargain_gain 285.2, so operating PBT ex-gain is VND 70.5bn and the gain is 4.05x it. CONDITION MET from this file's own fields. CONDITION MET, ROBUSTLY - the conclusion does not depend on the tax rate I cannot observe. READING B - the Vietnamese statutory line 'loi nhuan thuan tu hoat dong kinh doanh', WHICH INCLUDES FINANCIAL INCOME: operating profit is then ~VND 975bn and VND 896bn does NOT exceed it. CONDITION NOT MET. SO: SEVENTH DEFECTIVE ARMED CRITERION AND THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL - THE ANSWER FLIPS ON AN UNDEFINED TERM, ON 20.3% OF THE BOOK. This file already lists 'KDH's undefined consolidation basis' among the six; this is a SECOND undefined term in the same name's criteria set. NOT DECLARED FIRED. Declaring a trigger-1 escalation on a reading I chose myself, when the other reading is at least as natural under Vietnamese GAAP, would be the worst error available this week. actuals._THE_STAKE_SEQUENCE_CONFIRMS_THE_896BN_M: THE OWNERSHIP PERCENTAGES ARRIVED AND THEY DEMONSTRATE ARITHMETICALLY WHAT THIS FILE HAD ONLY INFERRED. NEW, CONTEXT-CHECKED TO ZERO HITS IN BOTH FILES: '50.95', '48.95'. (The 2% transfer, the VND68.3bn, the VND896bn, the VND770bn/750bn record quarter and the FY targets ALL PRE-EXIST - most of the search that found this was RE-SEARCH NUMBER EIGHT.) THE SEQUENCE: KDH held 99.95% of CTY TNHH BDS BINH TRUNG MOI -> 49% TRANSFERRED, leaving 50.95% -> A FURTHER 2% ON 23-JUN-2026 FOR VND68.3bn, leaving 48.95%. 99.95 - 51 = 48.95 AND 50.95 - 2 = 48.95. BOTH CLOSE EXACTLY. THAT 2% IS THE TRANCHE THAT CROSSES 50%, AND CROSSING 50% IS LOSS OF CONTROL. On 07-AUG this file wrote verbatim: 'A VND68bn disposal cannot produce a VND896bn gain: this is a REMEASUREMENT OF THE RETAINED STAKE ON LOSS OF CONTROL, not a profit on the 2%. THAT MECHANISM IS MY READING OF THE ACCOUNTING, NOT A STATED ONE.' THE OWNERSHIP SEQUENCE IS INDEPENDENT OF THE GAIN AND LANDS ON THE SAME CONCLUSION. THE INFERENCE IS CONFIRMED, AND CONFIRMED BY A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT THAN PRODUCED IT - THE SECOND TIME IN TWO HOURS. STATED AT ITS TRUE WIDTH: crossing 50% is the standard trigger for loss of control and is fully consistent with a remeasurement, BUT CONTROL IS A SUBSTANCE TEST, NOT PURELY A THRESHOLD. This corroborates the reading; IT IS NOT THE ISSUER SAYING SO. AND THE PRICE PER PERCENT IS FLAT ACROSS TRANCHES, WHICH SHARPENS IT. VND68.3bn for 2% is VND34.15bn PER 1%; at that rate 49% is VND1,673.3bn, against the 'remaining ~VND1,675bn' this file already held. A 0.1% RECONCILIATION. SO THE CONTROL-CROSSING 2% CARRIED NO CONTROL PREMIUM: KDH RECEIVED VND68.3bn OF CASH AND BOOKED VND896bn OF FINANCIAL REVENUE. THAT GAP IS ACCOUNTING REMEASUREMENT, NOT CONSIDERATION. ONE INFERENCE THIS CHANGES, AND IT IS A RISK RESTATEMENT. The file carried 'the remaining ~VND1,675bn of the Binh Trung Moi transfer, CONTRACTED TO COMPLETE BY Q3'. BUT IF KDH STOOD AT 50.95% BEFORE THE 23-JUN TRANCHE, THE 49% HAD ALREADY TRANSFERRED BY THEN - so what remains is most likely CONSIDERATION OUTSTANDING, A RECEIVABLE, NOT AN UNEXECUTED TRANSFER. THAT IS A MATERIALLY DIFFERENT EXPOSURE: MONEY OWED RATHER THAN A DEAL PENDING. This is MY INFERENCE FROM THE PERCENTAGES, NOT A STATED FACT, and the H1 AUDITOR-REVIEWED STATEMENTS DUE FRI 14-AUG are the document that settles it. ITEM 43 IS NOT RESOLVED AND NOTHING HERE TOUCHES IT: the armed criterion still flips on the undefined term - READING A (PBT minus the gain) MET ROBUSTLY, READING B (loi nhuan thuan tu hoat dong kinh doanh, which includes financial income) NOT MET. CORROBORATING THE MECHANISM DOES NOT DEFINE 'OPERATING PBT'. SECTION 4 HUMAN-ONLY. NOT DECLARED FIRED. kdh._THE_K2_HUNT_MAY_BE_THE_WRONG_VARIABLE_2: THE FILE HAS BEEN HUNTING THE WRONG VARIABLE ON KDH'S LAND-USE FEE, AND THIS IS A CORRECTION TO THE QUESTION, NOT A NEW ANSWER. WHAT THE FILE ASSERTS AS THE MECHANISM: 'Land-use fee is the single largest cost input for a Vietnamese residential developer, AND IT IS COMPUTED AS THE LAND PRICE TABLE MULTIPLIED BY K.' On that basis it named exactly two unknowns and has been pursuing them: KDH'S PROJECT-SPECIFIC K2 VALUES, and WHICH PROJECTS HAVE ALREADY SETTLED THEIR FEE. WHAT TODAY'S COVERAGE SAYS: real-estate developers are LITTLE AFFECTED DIRECTLY on LARGE projects, because land-use fee on those IS TYPICALLY DETERMINED BY THE RESIDUAL / SURPLUS METHOD (phuong phap thang du), NOT BY THE TABLE TIMES K. The parties it names as materially exposed are MANUFACTURING AND COMMERCIAL-SERVICE TENANTS PAYING ANNUAL LAND RENT in areas where the table rose most. WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN A NEW NUMBER WOULD. IF KDH'S LARGE PROJECTS - GLADIA AND CLARITA ARE THE TWO THE FILE NAMES - ARE ASSESSED BY THE RESIDUAL METHOD, THEN K2 IS IRRELEVANT FOR THEM AND THE TWO UNKNOWNS THE FILE HAS BEEN CHASING ARE AIMED AT THE WRONG VARIABLE. THE PRIOR QUESTION IS: BY WHICH STATUTORY VALUATION METHOD IS EACH KDH PROJECT'S FEE ACTUALLY DETERMINED? THAT QUESTION IS NEW TO THIS FILE AND IT SITS UPSTREAM OF BOTH EXISTING ONES. THE DISCIPLINE, WHICH IS THE FILE'S OWN AND IS NOT RELAXED HERE. The coverage is T5 GENERAL COMMENTARY ABOUT 'doanh nghiep bat dong san' AS A CLASS, NOT ABOUT KDH. Vietnamese law provides SEVERAL valuation methods - comparison, income, surplus/residual, and the land-price-adjustment-coefficient method - and WHICH ONE APPLIES DEPENDS ON THE CASE. SO THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH THAT KDH IS ASSESSED BY THE RESIDUAL METHOD. IT ESTABLISHES THAT THE FILE'S STATED MECHANISM IS A SIMPLIFICATION WHOSE APPLICABILITY TO KDH'S LARGE PROJECTS IS NOW IN DOUBT, AND THAT THE DOUBT SHOULD BE RESOLVED BEFORE MORE EFFORT GOES INTO THE K2 HUNT. DIRECTIONALLY, AND STATED AS A LEAN NOT A CONCLUSION: IT POINTS TO A SMALLER DIRECT IMPACT ON KDH THAN THE RAW TABLE INCREASE SUGGESTS - the file recorded increases 'with the largest reported at EIGHT TIMES'. The file's standing line that 'THE DIRECTION IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND THE OBVIOUS READING IS NOT TAKEN' REMAINS CORRECT AND IS NOW BETTER SUPPORTED, because the obvious reading assumed a mechanism that may not apply. THE INSTRUMENT IDENTIFIER, WHICH THE FILE ALSO LACKS: HCMC'S TABLE IS NGHI QUYET 87/2025/NQ-HDND, effective 01-JAN-2026, the first table issued after the merger of HCMC with BINH DUONG and BA RIA-VUNG TAU, built under the 2024 Land Law on 'market principles'. ZERO HITS FOR '87/2025' OR 'Land Law 2024' anywhere in this repo. Peak figure recorded: VND481.1m/m2 for NON-AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION AND BUSINESS LAND in zone 1. AND THIS IS THE SECOND INSTRUMENT-IDENTIFIER GAP FOUND IN THREE HOURS. At 11:53 the SBV LDR change was on file by SUBSTANCE but not by INSTRUMENT; here the HCMC land table is on file by SUBSTANCE but not by INSTRUMENT. THE BANK PROVISIONING LEAST IS THE BANK RESERVED MOST. That is coherent - a bank already carrying 125.5% of its NPLs in reserves does not need to keep charging at the prior year's rate - AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT 'PROVISIONING-FLATTERED' IMPLIES. IT IS ALSO THE VCB PATTERN IN MINIATURE: LOW FLOW, HIGH STOCK, and at VCB the file already accepted that reading (2.05% intensity against 279% coverage is prudence, not flattery). actuals._CREDIT_INPUTS_FAIL_VERIFICATION_2026_07: ESCALATION. The two credit fields in this block cannot both describe the same thing, and which one is right decides whether VPB's forward scenarios are comfortable or very hard. ARITHMETIC: credit_q2 1,060,000 against credit_start_fy 962,000 is +10.19%, NOT the +24.6% recorded in credit_growth_ytd. One of the two is on a different basis. WHAT THE PRESS ACTUALLY SAYS, and it is two different statements: (a) CONSOLIDATED credit reached ~1.06 quadrillion in Q1/26, +10.2% on end-2025 - which reproduces credit_start_fy 962,000 exactly; (b) PARENT-BANK credit reached ~1.06 quadrillion after SIX months, +24.6%. So the likely defect is that credit_q2 is the Q1 CONSOLIDATED figure while credit_growth_ytd is the H1 PARENT figure - a PERIOD error and an ENTITY error, checks 1 and 2 of charter section 3, sitting side by side in one actuals block as though they described one quarter of one entity. LOGICAL CROSS-CHECK: consolidated credit is by construction >= parent credit. If parent was ~1.06 quadrillion at H1, consolidated at H1 must EXCEED 1.06 quadrillion. If H1 consolidated growth was +24.6%, the base branch needs only +8.3% more in H2 and is comfortable. If it was +10.2%, the base branch needs +22.5% in H2 - a step-change of the same character as the KDH handover finding. The company's own FY plan of +34% to 1.29 quadrillion consolidated is consistent with the 962,000 start, so the FY target basis IS consolidated. NOT RESOLVED and NOT GUESSED. THE SEQUENCE, NOW EXPLICIT. (1) 22-APR-2026, AGM: approved issuing shares TO INCREASE CHARTER CAPITAL FROM OWNER'S EQUITY - a bonus issue. (2) JULY 2026, WRITTEN SHAREHOLDER POLL, before 30-Jul: shareholders approved AMENDING that into a plan to ISSUE SHARES TO PAY A DIVIDEND FROM UNDISTRIBUTED ACCUMULATED POST-TAX PROFIT - a stock dividend. (3) 30-JUL-2026, BOARD RESOLUTION: implements it, 2.06bn shares at 26.04%, holders of 10 million shares receive over 2.6 million new ones, Q3-Q4/2026. SO IT IS A STOCK DIVIDEND, AND BOTH DESCRIPTIONS WERE CORRECT AT DIFFERENT TIMES. The conflict was not sloppy reporting; THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF CHANGED IN JULY. GENERAL LESSON WORTH MORE THAN THIS INSTANCE: when two sources give the same event different TECHNICAL labels, check whether the thing changed between them before deciding one source is wrong. This file's habit has been to treat conflicting labels as one of them being an error - here that habit would have discarded a true statement. WHY IT MATTERS, AND IT IS A REAL COST THIS FILE DID NOT HAVE. In Vietnam a STOCK DIVIDEND PAID FROM RETAINED EARNINGS IS A DIVIDEND DISTRIBUTION and attracts 5% personal income tax for individual holders; a BONUS ISSUE FROM OWNER'S EQUITY is a capital restructuring and is not taxed as a dividend at issuance. THE JULY AMENDMENT THEREFORE MOVED 2.06 BILLION SHARES FROM A NON-TAXABLE CAPITAL INCREASE INTO A TAXABLE DISTRIBUTION. cfa.py already carries TAX_DIVIDEND = 0.05 and has never applied it to this event. ORDER OF MAGNITUDE, FLAGGED AS SUCH: on a par-value basis, 0.2604 new shares x 10,000 par x 5% = ~130 VND of tax per share held, which is 0.52% of the 25,000 price on file. NOT A PRECISE NUMBER - the timing (tax is generally collected on disposal) and the base are both matters this file has not verified, and the draft MoF decree carried in cfa.py as TAX_GAINS_DRAFT = 0.20 is explicitly NOT LAW. It is recorded to size the issue, not to model it. AND IT EXPOSES A GAP NEXT TO OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 3. That item asks for a cash_yield convention. THERE IS NO CONVENTION AT ALL FOR STOCK-DIVIDEND TAX, and three of the eight names have undated stock issues pending - VPB 26%, MBB 15%, TCB 60%. Whichever convention a human sets for cash should be set for stock in the same sitting.

actuals._THE_CROSS_SECTION_IS_COMPLETE_AND_THE_N: H1/2026, provisioning intensity (flow, % of PPOP) vs NPL coverage (stock): VCB 2.05% / 279% · TCB 8.0% / 125.5% · MBB 27.6% / 93.63% · VPB 45.2% / 56.2%. Four banks with both numbers, perfectly inverse ordering. THAT PERFECTION IS NOT EVIDENCE: coverage is the stock and intensity is the flow required to hold or rebuild it, so a thinly-reserved bank facing a growing NPL book MUST run a heavy flow to stand still. The relationship is close to what the definitions imply; a clean rank ordering across n=4 is the expected result, not a discovery. WHAT IT DOES SETTLE IS THE SIGN. The standing instruction is 'watch provisions and LLR because banks might be managing earnings.' The naive detector - low provisioning = suspicious - is BACKWARDS at the top of this table. VCB provisions least and is reserved most: its light flow is the CONSEQUENCE of a heavy stock, not a suppression of it. VPB's heavy flow is not conservatism - it is the running cost of the thinnest buffer in the set. Read alone, intensity gets both of them wrong. The detector that works is the PAIR: earnings are being flattered when the flow is light AND the stock is thin. On that test not one of the four qualifies - every light-flow bank here is a well-reserved one. The name nearest the danger quadrant is MBB (mid flow 27.6%, stock 93.63%, below 100%), which is exactly where item 26 already points. The instruction survives; its usual heuristic does not.

actuals._THE_FLOW_HAPPENED_TODAY_NOT_MONDAY_2026: CORRECTION TO AN ESCALATION THIS FILE RAISED THREE HOURS AGO. At 15:53 today I escalated trigger 5 with the words 'TCX joins VN30 on MONDAY 3 AUGUST. Today is the last session before it.' The escalation was correctly raised under the rule - a dated catalyst inside 5 sessions of a proposed trade - but the CHARACTERISATION WAS WRONG IN THE WAY THAT MATTERS. TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES THIS SWEEP: the ETFs tracking VN30 COMPLETE THEIR PORTFOLIO RESTRUCTURING ON 31-JULY-2026, ahead of the new basket's EFFECTIVE date of 03-AUG-2026. That is the standard mechanic - index funds trade at the close of the last session before an effective date, they do not trade on it. SO THE BUYING WAS TODAY. By Monday it is done. Anyone reading my 15:53 wording would have expected the flow on Monday and would have been a session late. AN EFFECTIVE DATE IS NOT A FLOW DATE. Same species as everything else caught this week: two different quantities sharing one label. The date gate has carried '3-Aug' since 26-Jul and it was never wrong about the index; it was silently wrong about WHEN THE MONEY MOVES, because nobody asked. TRIGGER 5 IS THEREFORE RESOLVED, NOT PENDING. The catalyst has landed. No trade was proposed as executed and none was placed - the escalation existed to put the date in front of a human before it passed, and what it should have said is that the date had effectively already passed. THE SIZING ON FILE IS CONFIRMED AGAIN AND BY A THIRD PARTY'S OWN FRAMING. ACBS: TCX 1.3m shares, 59bn; this file carries ~60bn and 0.073% of market cap. Also in the same rebalance: MCH +384bn, FPT +164bn, VHM +63bn, against TPB -35bn and PLX -83bn on removal; >486bn net across the basket. AND A FOURTH-PARTY HEADLINE NOW ASKS WHY 'THE ETFs BOUGHT A NEGLIGIBLE AMOUNT' of the two additions - independent corroboration of the conclusion this file reached on 30-Jul, that the VN30 catalyst is a rounding error against an 82,215bn market cap. actuals._THE_EXACT_WEIGHTS_THE_28_JUL_NOTE_SAID_: THE 28-JUL NOTE SAID 'WHY IT MATTERS EVEN WITHOUT THE EXACT WEIGHTS'. THE EXACT WEIGHTS ARE NOW IN HAND AND THEY ARE MORE DECISIVE THAN THAT NOTE COULD ASSUME. FTSE GEIS inclusion runs in FOUR tranches: 21-SEP-2026 AT 10% OF INVESTABILITY WEIGHT, then March 2027 at 20%, June 2027 at 35% and September 2027 at 35%. Cumulatively 10 / 30 / 65 / 100. SO THE DAY THE EVENT TREE PRICES DELIVERS ONE TENTH OF THE INCLUSION. ftse_event_tree prices 21-Sep as one discrete event at +20% (p=0.35) / +5% (p=0.45) / -15% (p=0.20), EV +6.25%. NINETY PERCENT OF THE INCLUSION FLOW ARRIVES ACROSS THREE 2027 DATES - all of them AFTER forecast #7 resolves on ~21-OCT-2026. SIZED AGAINST THE INDEX. Vietnam's projected weight at FULL inclusion is 0.22% of the FTSE Emerging Index and 0.34% of Emerging All Cap. AT THE FIRST TRANCHE THAT IS 0.022% AND 0.034% RESPECTIVELY, SPREAD ACROSS 28 VIETNAMESE STOCKS, of which TCX is one. Also 0.04% of Global All Cap and 0.02% of All-World at full weight. AND THE TWO SIDES OF SEPTEMBER ARE NOT SYMMETRIC, WHICH IS NEW. DELETION FROM THE FTSE FRONTIER INDEX SERIES IS A SINGLE TRANCHE at the September 2026 Frontier annual review - NOT PHASED. So 21-Sep-2026 carries ONE HUNDRED PERCENT OF THE FRONTIER EXIT AND TEN PERCENT OF THE EMERGING ENTRY. Those are opposite directions on one date. NOT NETTED, BECAUSE THIS FILE CANNOT NET THEM. Doing so requires Frontier-tracking AUM with Vietnam exposure against Emerging-tracking AUM applied to a 0.022% day-one weight, and neither figure is on file. Vietnam was a large weight in a small index family and becomes a tiny weight in a large one, which is a reason the netting is genuinely uncertain rather than obviously positive. STATING A DIRECTION HERE WOULD BE INVENTING ONE. THE 28-JUL COUNTER-ARGUMENT IS PRESERVED AND STILL STANDS: passive money moves mechanically on effective dates, but markets front-run reclassifications, so the price response on the day need not be proportional to the mechanical flow. That cuts both ways here - it is also why a 10% tranche could still move price, and why an already-banked announcement effect could leave the day flat. WHAT THIS ADDS TO OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 5, which already asks whether to re-weight or retire the tree on three grounds (phasing, not wired into decide.py, four straight years of foreign net selling): A FOURTH AND THE MOST CONCRETE - the tree's magnitudes describe a full reclassification and the date it prices delivers a tenth of one side of it. NOTHING CHANGED: forecast #7 was pre-registered and resolves ~21-Oct; re-weighting it now on evidence about mechanics would be the post-hoc adjustment pre-registration exists to prevent. The tree is human-only under charter s4.
actuals._TCX_EQUITY_IS_FILED_NOW_AND_THREE_FIGUR: ESCALATION TRIGGER 4 (a held name's evidence status changes - an estimate becomes a filed actual). actuals._THE_CORRECTION_MOVES_A_KILL_CRITERION_F: THIS IS THE CONSEQUENCE OF THE P/B FINDING AND IT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT LINE IN TODAY'S SWEEP. decide.py carries a TCX kill criterion: 'P/B < 2.0x on unchanged earnings = the re-rating case is dead', status armed. NOTE THE DIRECTION - for this name a FALLING multiple kills the thesis, because the thesis is a re-rating. Under the 2.49x the evidence string asserts, that trigger sits 24.5% away and reads as remote. Under the reproducible 2.075x it sits 3.8% away. THE TRIGGER PRICE IS 39,616 (2.0 x 45,782bn / 2,311,308,021 shares) AGAINST A FILE PRICE OF 41,100. Nothing about the company changed and no price moved - a denominator was corrected and a kill criterion went from remote to close. STATED WITH THE CAVEAT THAT CUTS THE OTHER WAY, AND IT IS A REAL ONE: the 41,100 price is stale and this file has already logged that it is a TROUGH, not a random day (_THE_PRICE_DATE_IS_A_TROUGH_NOT_A_RANDOM_DAY_2026_08_02). If TCX has traded up since, the actual distance is larger and possibly much larger. SO THE HONEST STATEMENT IS NOT 'THE KILL CRITERION IS ABOUT TO FIRE'. It is that the distance to it was MISMEASURED BY A FACTOR OF ABOUT SIX, and that the input needed to measure it correctly - a current, dated price - is the same OPEN-DECISIONS item 2 that has been outstanding for days. THE KILL CRITERION IS NOT DECLARED FIRED and is not resized; that is a human's call at the next brief (charter section 4). WHAT A HUMAN SHOULD DO WITH IT: refresh TCX's price with a date, then re-run this one division. It is the cheapest high-stakes check in the book right now. ALSO NOTE the criterion says 'on UNCHANGED EARNINGS' - equity grew 3.8% YTD, so the book value denominator RISES over time and mechanically pulls P/B down toward the trigger even at a flat price. That drift is now quantified and was not before.
actuals._WITHDRAWN_THE_09_53_SHARE_COUNT_WAS_PRE: FULL WITHDRAWAL OF THE 09:53 P/B FINDING, WRITTEN 90 MINUTES AFTER IT WAS PUSHED. WHAT 09:53 SAID: that TCX has 2,311,308,021 shares, that P/B is 2.075x not 2.49x, that '2.49x CANNOT BE REPRODUCED from any combination of this file's inputs and TCBS's filed equity', and that a kill criterion had moved from 24.5% away to 3.8% away. ALL OF THAT IS WRONG. THE ERROR: 2,311,308,021 is the LISTING-DATE share count (21-Oct-2025). TCX PAID A 20% STOCK DIVIDEND (5:1) IN Q2/2026 - 462.3m new shares, charter capital 23,115.8bn -> 27,739bn - so the current count is 2,773,896,000. CONFIRMED THREE WAYS, INDEPENDENTLY: (1) charter capital 27,739bn at 10,000 par = 2,773,900,000; (2) the reported 24-Jul market cap of 108,758.6bn divided by the reported 24-Jul price of 39,200 = 2,774,454,082; (3) 2,311,583,496 x 1.2 = 2,773,900,195. All three agree to within 0.02%. THE CONSEQUENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: 41,100 x 2,773,896,000 / 45,782bn = 2.4902x. THE FILE'S 2.49x IS EXACTLY RIGHT AND WAS RIGHT ALL ALONG. It reproduces to four significant figures. The evidence string never needed restating and the 09:53 restatement was the error, not the fix. THE KILL CRITERION IS NOT NEAR. Trigger price is 2.0 x 45,782bn / 2,773,896,000 = 33,010, NOT 39,616. At the file price of 41,100 the criterion is 24.5% away - exactly where the original 2.49x implied - and at the verified 24-Jul price of 39,200 it is 18.8% away. NOTHING WAS EVER 3.8% AWAY. WHAT SURVIVES FROM 09:53, UNAFFECTED: TCBS's filed equity of 45,782bn and the 1.13x margin ratio; the withdrawal of the 31-Jul 1.56x derivation; headroom of 40,064bn; HSC/KBSV/Phu Hung past 190%; the three-values-for-one-quantity finding; the margin-figure resolution; USD/VND; the VNDiamond waiting-list finding. Those rest on filed equity, not on the share count. WHAT ALSO SURVIVES AND GOT WORSE: the market cap gap. See the trigger-3 note below.
actuals._ESCALATION_TRIGGER_3_THE_ENGINE_PRICES_: ESCALATION TRIGGER 3 - EXPECTED RETURN MOVES MORE THAN 10pp. IT MOVES 34.3pp. THIS IS THE LARGEST SINGLE-NAME ERROR FOUND SO FAR AND IT IS IN THE ENGINE, NOT IN THE NARRATIVE. decide.py line 67 computes cap_now = pe_ttm x npat_ttm, and every expected return is (exit_pe x fy26e_npat) / cap_now - 1. For TCX that is 20.3 x 4,050 = 82,215bn. THE TRUE MARKET CAP IS 2,773,896,000 SHARES x 41,100 = 114,007bn, and at the verified 24-Jul price of 39,200 it is 108,737bn - corroborated by the independently reported 108,758.6bn. cap_now is 38.7% BELOW the real market cap, so every branch is divided by too small a number and every branch return is overstated. THE ARITHMETIC, ON UNCHANGED BRANCHES AND UNCHANGED PROBS: at cap_now 82,215bn, mu_raw = +23.1%. At the file price, mu_raw = -11.2%. At the verified 24-Jul price, mu_raw = -6.9%. A MOVE OF 34.3pp, AND IT CHANGES SIGN. TCX IS RANKED FIRST BY THE ENGINE AND IS A PROPOSED ADD; on the corrected market cap it has a NEGATIVE expected return. WHICH INPUT IS WRONG IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT GUESSED. Either pe_ttm should be 28.15 rather than 20.3, or npat_ttm should be 5,616bn rather than 4,050bn, or both are stale from before the 20% stock dividend. THE DIRECTION DOES NOT DEPEND ON RESOLVING THAT: market cap is shares x price, both are now established, so cap_now is too low whichever input caused it. WHY NOTHING IS RETUNED HERE. Changing pe_ttm or npat_ttm while the measure is unresolved is exactly the quiet retune charter section 5 forbids, and decide.py itself is scope-locked under section 4. Moving confidence would not fix it either - confidence multiplies mu_raw, so shrinking it scales a wrong number rather than correcting it, which is the lesson already on file from 31-Jul ('where a print invalidates the branches in either direction, the correct action is to escalate for re-derivation, never to move the scalar'). ESCALATED FOR A HUMAN, NOT APPLIED. THE FIX IS ONE READ: TCBS's TTM NPAT off the filed statements, which also settles pe_ttm. NOTE THE SAME DEFECT MAY EXIST ON OTHER NAMES - cap_now is pe_ttm x npat_ttm for all eight, and this file has no share count for any of them, so no ticker's market cap has ever been cross-checked against shares x price. That check has not been run and is not claimed here.

actuals._TCX_IS_THE_COUNTER_EXAMPLE_ITS_EARNINGS: COMPLETES THE EARNINGS-QUALITY SWEEP ACROSS THE BOOK, AND TCX IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE. THAT MATTERS: after finding provisioning flattery at TCB, MBB and VPB and an unevaluable FVTPL test at VPX, the risk is concluding that every name is managing earnings. TCX IS NOT. IT IS THE OPPOSITE. Q2/2026: REVENUE 3,745bn UP 41%, PBT 2,097bn UP ONLY 21%. Costs went from 923bn to 1,648bn, UP 78.6% - NEARLY DOUBLE - and the PBT margin fell from 65.2% to 56.0%, a 9.3pp compression. PROFIT GREW AT HALF THE RATE OF REVENUE. Where the banks' reported profit outran their operating line, TCX's lags its own top line. Nothing here is being flattered; if anything the reported number understates the franchise's growth. THE STRIKING LINE, AND IT IS NOT REASSURING. TCBS ARRANGED ~61,000bn OF BOND ISSUANCE IN Q2, UP 138%, of which ~59,000bn was non-bank corporate paper - A 48% MARKET SHARE AND NUMBER ONE IN VIETNAM. YET THE CAPITAL-MARKETS AND BOND-DISTRIBUTION NET INCOME WAS 964bn, UP JUST 7% - THE SLOWEST-GROWING SEGMENT IT HAS. VOLUME UP 138% PRODUCED INCOME UP 7%. Either fee rates compressed severely, or the incremental volume is being arranged at very low margin, or the segment line nets off something not disclosed here. WHICH OF THOSE IS TRUE IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT GUESSED - but a franchise adding 138% more volume for 7% more income is not converting share into earnings, and that is a question about the QUALITY OF THE GROWTH rather than the quality of the accounting. AND IT JOINS UP WITH THE 18:53 FINDING, WHICH IS WHY IT IS LOGGED HERE RATHER THAN AS A CURIOSITY. TCBS is registrar and depositary for Masterise-linked paper, confirmed from tcbs.com.vn for lot IHP32602. Masterise-linked issuance in H1 was 44,500bn across six enterprises. Against TCX's ~59,000bn of non-bank corporate paper arranged in Q2 alone, THE MASTERISE EXPOSURE SITS INSIDE THE 964bn SEGMENT THAT IS GROWING AT 7%. So the part of TCX most connected to the property-bond complex is also its weakest-growing line. NOT SIZED: what share of TCBS's arranged volume is Masterise-linked is NOT established. VCI NEEDS NO SEPARATE SEARCH - the file already carries its version: Q2 profit -26% QoQ (251 vs 341) behind a +36% YoY headline, revenue flat, operating cash flow negative and funded by borrowings, prop book -430bn on FPT/MWG/KDH. That is the same lens already applied. SO THE BOOK-WIDE EARNINGS-QUALITY PICTURE IS NOW COMPLETE: THREE BANKS FLATTERED BY FALLING PROVISIONING INTENSITY (TCB 5.8pp, MBB 9.2pp, VPB 23.4pp of their growth), ONE BROKER WITH AN UNEVALUABLE FVTPL TEST (VPX), ONE BROKER WHOSE PROFIT IS SHRINKING BEHIND ITS HEADLINE (VCI), AND ONE WHOSE PROFIT LAGS ITS OWN REVENUE (TCX). KDH's one-off deconsolidation gain and HPG's Q1 divestment gain are already documented. CONFIDENCE NOT MOVED (0.75). The finding is favourable to TCX's accounting and unfavourable to its operating leverage, and those offset; and TCX's live issue remains the multiple and the undated price, not the earnings. Nothing modelled.
actuals._THE_FRANCHISE_TEST_CANNOT_BE_COMPLETED_:
RAN THE TEST NAMED AT 12:53 - 'TCBS's fee franchise does not sit on the balance sheet and cannot show up in ROA; THAT is the test that would actually settle it'. IT CANNOT BE COMPLETED FROM PUBLIC DATA, AND SAYING SO IS THE FIRST RESULT.

THE MEASURE MISMATCH THAT BLOCKS IT. The segment figures disclosed are 'THU NHAP THUAN' - NET income - while the 3,745bn headline is 'TONG DOANH THU', GROSS revenue. Investment banking 837bn (+33%) and treasury-and-bond-distribution 964bn (+7%) ARE NOT SHARES OF 3,745bn AND MUST NOT BE DIVIDED INTO IT. The internal check that proves it: 837 + 964 = 1,801bn, which is 85.9% of PBT of 2,097bn - and margin lending and brokerage would still have to cover ALL operating expense out of the remaining 14%. THE SUM DOES NOT WORK AGAINST EITHER DENOMINATOR, so neither ratio is admissible. NO FEE SHARE OF REVENUE IS COMPUTED. This is the fifth comparison refused for want of a common basis in fourteen hours.

WHAT IS ESTABLISHED WITHOUT THE RATIO, AND IT SUPPORTS TCX. TCBS HAS A REAL FEE FRANCHISE AND VPS ESSENTIALLY HAS NONE. Q2/2026 bond issuance arranged ~61,000bn, +138%, of which NON-BANK CORPORATE ~59,000bn - 96.7% of the total - AT 48% MARKET SHARE. IB net income 837bn, +33%, equal to 39.9% of group PBT. Against that, VPS's growth was interest income +95% to 44% of operating revenue WITH BROKERAGE REVENUE FALLING. SO THE 12:53 ROA COMPARISON IS UNFAIR TO TCBS IN EXACTLY THE DIRECTION FLAGGED - 837bn of IB income requires almost no balance sheet, and ROA charges TCBS for assets that earn a different line. THE 12:53 ENTRY SAID THIS WAS THE UNTESTED DEFENCE. IT IS NOW A PARTLY EVIDENCED ONE, AND IT IS RECORDED AS SUCH RATHER THAN LEFT AS AN OBJECTION I RAISED AND DID NOT ANSWER.

AND IT RELOCATES THE RISK RATHER THAN REMOVING IT, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MATTERS. THE FRANCHISE DEFENDING TCX'S PREMIUM IS A PROPERTY-BOND ORIGINATION FRANCHISE. This file already holds, from 31-Jul and 04-Aug: TCX is tied to 'the ecosystem containing major investors associated with projects like Masterise'; Masterise-linked issuance was 44,500bn in H1/2026; NEW PROPERTY-BOND ISSUE RATES HAVE REPRICED TO 11.5-12%, up ~1pp year-on-year; and VIS Rating puts ~60,000bn of REAL-ESTATE bonds maturing in H2/2026, close to half of all corporate maturities. THE PREMIUM IS DEFENDED BY AN EARNINGS STREAM WHOSE UNDERLYING MARKET THIS FILE HAS SEPARATELY DOCUMENTED AS REPRICING. AND THE INTERNAL EVIDENCE POINTS THE SAME WAY: the TREASURY-AND-BOND-DISTRIBUTION line - the segment most connected to that complex, and the one the 02-Aug entry already identified as 'the 964bn segment growing at 7%' - IS STILL TCBS'S WEAKEST LINE AT +7% while origination grew 138%. ORIGINATING FAST AND DISTRIBUTING SLOWLY IS A DIFFERENT BUSINESS FROM ORIGINATING AND DISTRIBUTING FAST, AND WHERE THE DIFFERENCE ENDS UP IS NOT ESTABLISHED HERE. NOT INFERRED, NAMED.

NEW AND ADVERSE, AND IT IS THE KIND OF THING THE STANDING INSTRUCTION ASKS FOR: A RECORD-PROFIT HEADLINE CONCEALING MARGIN COMPRESSION. VPX carries an ARMED KILL CRITERION on exactly this: 'FVTPL marks > 50% of PBT for a THIRD consecutive quarter'. THE QUARTERLY SEQUENCE, RECONSTRUCTED. Q2/2026 is filed: PBT 2,159bn (4x YoY) and FVTPL GROSS GAINS 1,639bn (2.7x YoY), the largest single line in a total operating revenue of 4,098bn. H1 PBT is 2,673bn and H1 FVTPL 3,461bn, so BY SUBTRACTION Q1/2026 WAS PBT 514bn ON FVTPL GAINS OF 1,822bn.   Q1/2026: FVTPL is 354% of PBT. Q2/2026: 76%. H1: 129%. THAT IS TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS ABOVE THE 50% TEST ON A GROSS READING - and the criterion needs three, so IT HAS NOT FIRED, and whether Q3 would be the third depends on Q4/2025, which is NOT on file. That RECONCILES with the new figure and explains it: 1,639 GROSS GAIN minus 923 LOSS = 716 NET, which is the '>700bn' already on record. For contrast, the KDH insider BUY logged on 27-Jul was ~2.0% of that company - roughly 23 times larger as a proportion. WHAT CANNOT BE SAID: his TOTAL holding is unknown, so there is no way to tell whether this is a trim or an exit, and that is the difference between a non-event and a signal. actuals._VOLUME_CORROBORATED_AND_A_BASKET_TRAP_2: CORROBORATION of the Q2 volume that this morning's pre-registered read depends on, from a second independent route. HRC reconciles three ways: Q2 1.9mt stated as +31% on Q1 implies Q1 1.45mt, so H1 = 3.35mt against a separately reported 'nearly 3.4mt' - and subtracting the 5-month HRC figure of 2.7mt leaves June at 0.65mt against a Q2 monthly average of 0.63mt. Both match. The 3.5mt Q2 basket figure is sound. BASKET TRAP - disarm this before a future run walks into it. A 5-month TOTAL steel sales figure of 5.9mt circulates. Subtracting it from the 6.5mt H1 basket gives 'June = 0.6mt', which against Q2's 1.17mt monthly average would look like a 49% COLLAPSE in June volumes. IT IS NOT. The 5.9mt figure INCLUDES pipe (453kt in H1) and galvanised sheet (189kt in H1); the 6.5mt basket EXCLUDES both. On the same basket, 5 months is ~5.37mt, leaving June at ~1.13mt against a Q2 average of 1.17mt - entirely normal. A second tell: the growth rates differ, +24% for the 5-month figure versus +32% for H1, which two identical baskets could not produce. DO NOT SUBTRACT VOLUME FIGURES FROM DIFFERENT SOURCES WITHOUT CHECKING WHICH PRODUCTS EACH INCLUDES. Same class as _HRC_BENCHMARK_TRAP_2026_07_28. Q2 forecasts now cleanly attributed: SSI Research 6,500bn, HSC 6,400bn. Still UNFILED as of 13:53 ICT 28-Jul. No input changed.

actuals._BEAR_BRANCH_MAY_NOT_BE_BEARISH_ENOUGH_2: VCBS forecasts HPG FY2026 NPAT of 18,055bn (+17%) on revenue of 194,330bn. Our BEAR branch is 18,061bn. A 0.03% match - which is either strong agreement or a basis mismatch, and the difference decides whether there is a finding here at all. OURS IS CORE, ex the 4,123bn Pho Noi divestment gain. VCBS's is almost certainly TOTAL: the forecast is dated ~19-Jun, AFTER Q1 in which that gain was booked as an actual, and a broker forecasting full-year reported NPAT after Q1 has to include it unless it says otherwise. ON THAT READING, like for like: VCBS core = 18,055 - 4,123 = 13,932bn, which is 23% BELOW OUR WORST CASE. The most conservative broker on the street would be well under our bear branch. INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK from the spread bridge, which was built without reference to any broker: Q1 core 5,046 + Q2 3.5mt at 1.60-1.86m/t + H2 7-9mt at the spot margin of 0.60-0.68m/t gives an FY core of roughly 14,800-16,800bn. That sits BETWEEN VCBS-core and our bear. SO THREE ROUTES POINT THE SAME WAY - the bridge at spot prices, VCBS adjusted to core, and the arithmetic above - and all three say the 18,061bn bear branch is NOT BEARISH ENOUGH. This is the same conclusion the spot_persists recommendation reached on 26-Jul from the per-tonne side, now reached from the full-year side. THE IF THAT MATTERS: if VCBS's 18,055 is itself core, it matches our bear exactly and none of this holds. That is the less likely reading but it is not impossible, and it is settled by looking at whether VCBS's FY25 base of ~15,432bn (18,055/1.17) is a core or reported figure. NOT RESOLVED. NOTHING CHANGED - branches, probabilities and confidence all stand. Adding or lowering a branch is a judgment call reserved for a human, and doing it on an inferred basis mismatch would be worse than leaving it. Recorded because HPG reports within days and this is the direction of the risk.
actuals._q2_2025_ANCHOR_2026_07_29: Year-ago comparator added so tomorrow's print reads in growth terms as well as absolute. Q2/2025 NPAT was 4,256.75bn (+28.24% on Q2/2024). IT RECONCILES ALL THREE FORECASTS, which is why it is worth holding: SSI 6,500 = +52.7% (they quote +52%), HSC 6,400 = +50.3% (+49%), VCBS 5,335 = +25.3% (+25%). Base and growth rates are consistent, so none of the three is quoting off a different year-ago figure. PER-TONNE ANCHOR. Q2/26 volume of 3.5mt is stated as +35% YoY, implying Q2/25 volume of ~2.59mt and a year-ago NPAT/tonne of ~1.64m. Q1/26 CORE was 1.682m/t. So the two most recent comparable quarters both sit at roughly 1.64-1.68m/t. AGAINST THE BRANCHES: bear 1.25m/t is -24% on that level, base 1.60m/t is -3%, bull 1.85m/t is +13%. The bear branch therefore requires a 24% margin compression from where the business has actually been for two consecutive quarters - which is what the spread bridge says is coming, but NOT in Q2, because Q2 burns Q1's cheap inputs. See TIMING. CAVEAT: 4,256.75 is TOTAL Q2/25 NPAT and may contain one-offs, so 1.64m/t is an UPPER BOUND on the year-ago core figure. Tier T5. Not used to change any branch.

actuals._SEGMENT_SPLIT_RESOLVES_THE_ANCHOR_2026_: THE MOST USEFUL LINE IN THE RELEASE, and it settles the anchor question raised at 13:53. Steel is 93% of H1 REVENUE but only 68% of H1 PROFIT. H1 steel NPAT = 15,480 x 0.68 = 10,526bn on 6.5mt = 1.619m/t. H1 NON-steel = 4,954bn, and it RECONCILES: Pho Noi one-off 4,123 + agriculture ~648 = 4,771, leaving a residual of ~183. So non-steel is overwhelmingly the ONE-OFF, not a recurring earnings stream. WHAT THAT DOES TO THE 13:53 FINDING: the contamination is real but SMALLER than the raw 32% suggests. Ex the Pho Noi gain, recurring non-steel is only ~7.3% of H1 core profit - close to the 6.4% estimated from agriculture alone. So the 1.682m/t Q1 anchor is roughly 7% too high, not 32%, and the solved conversion cost is understated by about that much. Direction unchanged, magnitude now bounded.
actuals._FORWARD_READ_2026_07_29: H1 core, ex the 4,123 one-off, is 11,357bn - about 5,678bn a quarter. Against the CORE branches: BEAR 18,061 now needs H2 of 6,704bn, which is 3,352/qtr - a 41% COLLAPSE from the H1 pace. BASE 23,336 needs 11,979bn, 5,990/qtr - roughly FLAT on H1. BULL 28,061 needs 16,704bn, 8,352/qtr - up 47%. AS MARGIN, on H2 volume of 7-9mt: bear implies 0.745-0.958 m/t, base 1.331-1.711, bull 1.856-2.386.
