actuals._THE_NONINTEREST_COLLAPSE_THE_FILE_NEVER: ANALYST-ASSERTED: 'Thu ngoai lai 6 thang giam 28,8%, rieng ngoai hoi giam 90% va chung khoan dau tu gan nhu ve 0. Ty trong thu nhap lai thuan da len 84% tong thu nhap.' VERIFIED INTERNALLY, NO EXTERNAL SOURCE USED: q1_nii 14,913 + q2_nii 16,893.65 = VND 31,806.65bn over h1_toi 37,865 = 84.00% EXACT. The -28.8% then closes the income statement: H1 non-interest income = 37,865 - 31,806.65 = VND 6,058.3bn; prior-year non-II = 6,058.3/0.712 = VND 8,508.9bn, a FALL OF VND 2,450.6bn; prior TOI = 37,865/1.163 = VND 32,558bn so prior non-II share was 26.13%; prior NII = VND 24,049.1bn giving NII +32.3%. Recomposition returns VND 37,865bn on the nose, and prior H1 PBT back-solves to VND 15,883.6bn against the file's H1/25 figure of VND 15,884bn. WHAT IT MEANS: q2_nii +36.55% has been on file since 31-Jul and THE -28.8% COLLAPSE BESIDE IT NEVER WAS - the file recorded the good half of the income statement and not the bad half. MBB's +27.1% PBT growth is built on spread income alone while NIM is 3.9% against 5.8% in 2022 and cost of funds has risen four consecutive quarters (both analyst-asserted, unverified). Volume, not price - which is exactly why management plans credit +30-35% against profit +15-20%. The 16:53 finding now has its mechanism.
actuals._THE_CUSHION_IS_GONE_OR_IS_BEING_HELD_AN: FX -90% and investment securities ~0 are the two lines a bank normally uses to smooth a quarter. TWO READINGS AND THE FILE CANNOT SEPARATE THEM. (a) MBB HAS DRAINED THEM - in which case an H2 provisioning step-up to the 35.7% intensity item 26 requires hits PBT undamped, and management's +4.5% to +13.9% H2 guidance is honest. (b) MBB IS SITTING ON UNREALISED GAINS IT DECLINED TO TAKE in a half-year that already grew PBT 27.1%, which is the classic pattern the owner's standing instruction points at, and H2 is when they would be released. THE ASYMMETRY: holding gains back in a strong H1 to release them into a guided-weak H2 is precisely earnings management, and reading (b) is the one consistent with the owner's hypothesis. THE QUESTION NOBODY AT THE MEETING ASKED, AND THE FIELD THAT SEPARATES THE TWO READINGS: what are the UNREALISED GAINS in the investment securities book? It is in the notes to the 29-Aug reviewed statements. Recorded per the item-35 rule.
actuals._THE_MBV_QUESTION_I_DID_NOT_ASK_AND_IT_Q: An analyst asked 'MB co dang ban no cho MBV bao nhieu?' - HOW MUCH DEBT IS MB SELLING TO MBV. The 16:53 question drafted here was what MBV drags per quarter; THIS ONE ASKS WHETHER MBV IS WHERE MB'S BAD DEBT GOES, and it is the better question. IF NPLs are transferred to a transferee bank MB does not consolidate, then MBB's NPL 1.45% and coverage 93.63% are NOT measured on the same basis as TCB's 125.5% or VPB's 56.2%, and the cross-section published at 17:53 compares one adjusted number with two unadjusted ones. NOT WITHDRAWN - the consolidation basis is not established - but FLAGGED. Second time this week a cross-ticker ratio has turned out to rest on an unstated basis (cf. the coal index-vs-transaction withdrawal of 11:53).
actuals._REAL_ESTATE_CONCENTRATION_MBB_CRITERIA_: ANALYST-ASSERTED, UNVERIFIED: MBB's real-estate credit DOUBLED in 2025 and kept growing strongly in 1H26; developer lending is 12% of total loans and grew faster than total credit in Q2/26; questions were also asked on the mortgage share and the consumer-RE credit share at end-2025 vs Q2/26. THE GAP: TCB carries THREE armed real-estate criteria (RE share back above 32%; developer/related-party NPL formation > 2.0% or a Masterise bond event; the de-risking reverses). MBB CARRIES NONE. This is not a defective criterion - it is a MISSING one, on a book that doubled in a year. Seventh criteria defect this week and the first of the ABSENCE type. Charter s4 human-only.
actuals._THE_CAPITAL_RAISE_IS_REQUIRED_NOT_OPPOR: The meeting opened with 'CAR to get 10.5% in next 2 years' and carried two separate questions on 2026-2027 debt and Tier 2 issuance and on foreign borrowing (tenor and rate). AGAINST CREDIT PLANNED AT +30-35% A YEAR, an RWA base compounding at that rate under a 10.5% CAR target makes the 11-Aug rights issue a RECURRING NEED, NOT A ONE-OFF. That reframes the 18:53 trigger-5 entry: the VND 8,055bn rights is an instalment, and the VND 2,000bn 200m-share placement behind it is the next one. actuals._SCORED_MY_OWN_CEO_QUESTION_LIST_2_OF_7_: The seven questions drafted for MBB management on 05-Aug 15:53, scored against what analysts actually asked. HIT (2): H2 provisioning - my top follow-up, asked nearly verbatim; and MBV - asked, but better. PARTIAL (1): where the 30-35% credit room comes from, approached via the real-estate questions. mbb._NO_DRIVER_MODEL_2026_07_28: MBB is NOT built by run.py. fy26e_npat 28,000/30,500/33,000 is asserted directly. INVERTING IT - the check the audit called for - the branches turn out to be COHERENT, which is worth saying plainly since the audit implied they might not be. At a 0.80 NPAT/PBT ratio they imply FY26 PBT of 35,000 / 38,125 / 41,250 against a company plan of 39,400-39,500. So base sits just below guidance and bull just above: a sensible spread AROUND the plan, not a number pulled from nowhere. Against npat_ttm 28,065 the branches are flat / +8.7% / +17.6% on trailing profit. WHAT REMAINS WRONG is not the level, it is that no driver produces it. TCB's base comes from credit +18%, NIM 3.3%, credit cost 0.5% - move any one and the branch moves. MBB's base comes from nothing, so it cannot be stress-tested: if SBV changes MBB's quota or NIM compresses, there is no lever to pull. That is the real cost of the gap, and it is a reason to BUILD the model, not to distrust the number. DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT TONIGHT. The H1 statement lands within about 48 hours and will supply loans, NIM, CIR and NPL as filed actuals. Building a driver block now from press summaries - one of which already mislabelled the period - then rebuilding it Thursday would waste the work and risk anchoring on the wrong numbers. mbb._PRE_REGISTERED_H2_READ_2026_07_28: Written BEFORE the H1 print. Each fy26e_npat branch implies a required SECOND-HALF PBT, so the H1 actual translates straight into which branch is still live. Required H2 growth versus H1: | H1 17,000 -> bear +5.9%, base +24.3%, bull +42.6% | H1 18,000 -> bear -5.6%, base +11.8%, bull +29.2% | H1 18,440 -> bear -10.2%, base +6.8%, bull +23.7% | H1 19,000 -> bear -15.8%, base +0.7%, bull +17.1% | H1 20,000 -> bear -25.0%, base -9.4%, bull +6.2% | H1 21,000 -> bear -33.3%, base -18.5%, bull -3.6%. If Q2 lands near the 8,812 estimate, H1 is ~18,440 and the base branch needs +11.7% on the Q2 quarterly run-rate. STATED FAIRLY: Vietnamese bank profit is seasonally second-half weighted, because credit quota gets used late and fee income concentrates at year-end, so +11.7% is not alarming on its own. What the table prevents is reading a big H1 as good news without checking what it leaves H2 needing - note that at H1 of 20,000 or above, even the BULL branch needs almost no further growth, which would mean the branches have stopped discriminating and need rebuilding rather than celebrating.
mbb._NO_CONSENSUS_FOR_THE_ONE_NAME_THAT_NEED: NO STREET CONSENSUS CAME BACK FOR MBB THIS HOUR, AND THAT IS WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE MBB IS THE NAME THAT NEEDS IT MOST. On 05-AUG at 04:53 this file logged Brent +2.8% to US$86.11 and called it 'the first datum on the reversal risk this file pre-stated' - the risk being that Vietnam's petrol- and food-driven July disinflation reverses with oil. THAT UP-DAY SAT INSIDE A WEEK THAT ENDED DOWN MORE THAN 7%. IT DID NOT MERELY FAIL TO GENERALISE - IT POINTED OPPOSITE TO THE WEEK IT BELONGED TO. The 05-AUG rule, 'one day up followed by one day down is noise around a stated mechanism, not evidence about it', is no longer a caution this file merely stated. IT IS NOW A SCORED ONE, AND THE ENTRY IT SCORES IS THIS FILE'S OWN. WARNING - THE TWO NUMBERS ARE NOT ON THE SAME CONTRACT, AND THAT IS AN EXISTING FAMILY MEMBER RATHER THAN A NEW ONE. US$83.52 is explicitly the OCTOBER contract; the US$86.11 of 04-AUG carries no contract at all. So 86.11 -> 83.52 = -3.0% IS NOT COMPUTED HERE AND MUST NOT BE QUOTED: it is INSTRUMENT SUBSTITUTION, MEMBER 4 OF THE NINE, and the sign of the roll is unknown without the curve shape - backwardation would flatter the fall, contango would exaggerate it. THE TAXONOMY CAUGHT A NEW INSTANCE INSIDE AN EXISTING MEMBER. THAT IS THE TAXONOMY WORKING, AND THE CORRECT RESPONSE IS TO RESIST ADDING A TENTH. NOR IS 31-JULY BACKED OUT OF THE PERCENTAGE: a >7% weekly fall closing near $83.5 implies a prior-Friday level near $90, AND THAT ARITHMETIC IS NOT RECORDED, because deriving a level from a rounded percentage is exactly the invention the 05-AUG entry refused to commit. HORMUZ IS TWO-SIDED AND MY WORKING READ AN HOUR AGO WAS ONE-SIDED. I had this as 'Iran's restrictive draft plan drove oil up'. THE FULLER PICTURE: an IRAN-OMAN agreement to RESTORE Hormuz shipping is live (millions of barrels returning); ADNOC reported ATTACKS ON THREE VESSELS transiting the strait; and Iran's draft, now before its parliament, sets conditions STRICTER THAN MARKETS ANTICIPATED - restrictions on US and Israeli vessels, compensation from states deemed hostile. Supply-restoring and supply-threatening headlines are running SIMULTANEOUSLY, which is what a >7% weekly fall with a +1.25% Friday looks like. ONE DETAIL NOT RESOLVED AND NOT FORCED: 05-AUG recorded a US-IRAN interim agreement; this source says IRAN-OMAN. Oman is the standing mediator channel for US-Iran contact, so these may be the same process at different removes. BOTH ARE RECORDED; NEITHER IS CORRECTED INTO THE OTHER. THE VIETNAM DIRECTION CUTS AGAINST THE THREAD I HAVE BEEN WATCHING: cheaper oil pushes the SAME way as the disinflation already on file - July CPI +4.45%, a second consecutive monthly fall, May confirmed as the peak. THE REVERSAL RISK PRE-STATED ON 03-AUG DID NOT MATERIALISE THIS WEEK; IT MOVED FURTHER AWAY. BUT A WEEK OF OIL IS NOT A CPI PRINT. CPI still sits about 0.95pp above risk.py's 3.5% threshold. ENVIRONMENT, NOT EVIDENCE. NO CONFIDENCE MOVES. NO MODEL INPUT TOUCHED. Tier T5.
_market._A_US_LEVY_ON_CHINESE_GOODS_IS_ABSENT_FR: A BOUNDED NEGATIVE RECORDED WITH THE ARGUMENT ON BOTH SIDES, SO THE NEXT SWEEP NEITHER RE-SEARCHES IT NOR MISTAKES THE SILENCE FOR IGNORANCE. REPORTED: 'Washington applied a new 12.5% levy on Chinese products in late July, replacing a temporary 10% rate that had lapsed.' A grep for any US-on-China tariff returned ZERO HITS IN THIS FILE AND ZERO IN monitoring-log.md. So this file tracks TWO SIDES OF A TRIANGLE - VIETNAM's AD duties on Chinese HRC, and US actions on VIETNAM - and not the third. THE ABSENCE IS REAL. IT STAYS UNTRACKED FOR THREE REASONS, STATED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. (1) UNDER-IDENTIFIED - no instrument, no docket, no exact date, only 'late July': the same instrument-identifier weakness this file called an INCONSISTENCY on 08-AUG. (2) THE CHANNEL IS ALREADY BLOCKED AT BOTH ENDS - diversion of Chinese steel INTO Vietnam meets Vietnam's own 19.38-27.83% HRC duties (460 and 1959/QD-BCT) plus the 27.83% wide-coil circumvention duty effective 17-APR-2026 (612/QD-BCT, with HPG a petitioner); and Chinese steel into the US already faces Section 232 plus AD/CVD orders FAR ABOVE 12.5%, so a general 12.5% is not marginal for steel. _market._THE_PER_NAME_FLOW_SPLIT_CONFIRMS_YESTER: THE PER-NAME BREAKDOWN OF THE 03-07 AUG FOREIGN NET BUY, AND IT TESTS A READING THIS FILE MADE BEFORE IT HAD THE DATA. NEW: FPT VND667bn, VIC VND617bn, CTG VND438bn, MBB VND415bn, HPG VND335bn. CONTEXT-CHECKED BEFORE CLAIMING NOVELTY: '415' returns one unrelated hit; '335' MATCHED ONLY VCBS'S VND5,335bn HPG Q2 ESTIMATE - SUBSTRING FALSE POSITIVE NUMBER SEVEN; '667' and '617' pre-exist as VCI's 1H PBT and other figures. At 09:53 on 09-AUG the AGGREGATE was logged - net BUY VND2,249.5bn on VALUE while net SELLING 10.3m UNITS - and the divergence was read as 'fewer shares, higher prices: ROTATION INTO BLUECHIPS'. THAT WAS AN INFERENCE FROM TWO AGGREGATES. THE PER-NAME SPLIT IS INDEPENDENT DATA AND ALL FIVE NAMED NET-BUYS ARE LARGE CAPS. SO FTSE ANTICIPATION CANNOT BE THE WHOLE EXPLANATION. BOUNDED DELIBERATELY: this file holds eligibility only for its own eight, so FPT, VIC and CTG cannot be tested and THE GENERAL CLAIM IS NOT MADE. _market._USD_VND_SET_ANOTHER_RECORD_AND_THIS_COM: SBV CENTRAL RATE VND25,380 ON 04-AUG-2026, AGAINST THE VND25,338 OF 01-AUG THIS FILE HOLDS AS THE PRIOR ALL-TIME HIGH. And the re-open triggers were chosen to be OBSERVABLE FROM INSIDE A SWEEP - 'the NEXT week's flow figures, Sat 15-AUG or later' and 'the AUGUST credit print, ~early Sep' - which is precisely the defect the 13:54 CADENCE NOTE identified in the TCB corporate-action row, where 're-open on a TCB announcement' was unobservable and therefore read as 'search every hour'. circular_25_2026_tt_nhnn.amends: Circular 22/2019/TT-NHNN, prudential limits and safety ratios
circular_25_2026_tt_nhnn._WHAT_IT_DOES: The SBV raised the maximum share of SHORT-TERM funding a bank may deploy into MEDIUM- AND LONG-TERM LENDING from 30% to 40%. It also brings deposits from other credit institutions into the safety ratio, with carve-outs for escrow, dedicated-capital deposits, State Treasury demand deposits and 80% of State Treasury term deposits. Published in the government gazette (congbao.chinhphu.vn, vanban.chinhphu.vn) and carried by the Vietnam Banks Association, so this is T1 official regulator text, not press about it. One published estimate puts the headroom created at around 1,000,000bn of additional medium- and long-term capacity system-wide, with REAL ESTATE named as a beneficiary.
circular_25_2026_tt_nhnn._WHY_IT_MATTERS_HERE: This is the single largest loosening of the constraint that actually binds Vietnamese bank loan growth, and it lands on 71.8% of this book - banks 51.5% plus KDH 20.3%. ON THE BANKS. Every bank model here forecasts CREDIT GROWTH as the primary driver, and the notes on VPB and MBB both frame H2 as demanding: VPB needs about +22.5% in H2 on one reading of its contradictory credit pair, and MBB needs roughly +15% to +22% depending on which FY target is right. Part of what made those look demanding was an unstated assumption that funding constraints bind as they did under the 30% cap. FROM 01-JUL THEY BIND LESS - and 01-Jul is exactly the start of the H2 those requirements describe. The H2 hurdle for VPB and MBB is therefore more achievable than the notes on file imply. This is the SECOND finding today pointing that way for MBB, after the credit trajectory was anchored at 14:53. ON KDH. Property is named as a direct beneficiary. Easier long-term bank funding helps developers refinance and helps their buyers get mortgages. KDH carries debt up 51% to 15.3tn with its land bank fully pledged, so its sensitivity to term-funding availability is high. NOT RETUNING ANYTHING. Charter s5: where new evidence bears on a THESIS rather than a NUMBER, it is escalated, not quietly worked into the branches. No probability, branch or weight changed. CONFIDENCE ALSO HELD, and the reason matters. This is T1, and charter s2 permits T1 to raise confidence to 0.90 - but confidence measures how well evidenced OUR SPECIFIC FORECASTS are, and a favourable change in the operating environment does not validate a number that still fails its own cross-check. VPB's two credit fields still contradict each other. A better environment for a figure we cannot verify is not better evidence for that figure.
circular_25_2026_tt_nhnn._HOW_THIS_WAS_MISSED: Issued 22-Jun, effective 01-Jul, in force for FOUR WEEKS and for the whole of the quarter this book has been analysing, and this repo had no record of it until 29-Jul 17:53. It surfaced only as a side clause in a market-recap search run for a different lane. THE SAME SPECIES AS THE 28-JUL LESSON about HPG's half-year volume disclosure sitting unlogged for three weeks: the lanes hunt for NEWS, and a circular published in the government gazette is not news - it is dated, scheduled, primary and findable. Lane 5 nominally covers 'SBV/MoF circulars'; in practice nothing was checking the gazette on a schedule. This is a process gap, not an information gap.

_regulatory._ITC_DATE_CHECKED_AND_HELD_AND_A_STALE_D: THE ~MID-SEPTEMBER ITC DATE ON FILE IS CONFIRMED, AND A CONFLICTING 'AUGUST' IS DISARMED BEFORE A FUTURE SWEEP WALKS INTO IT. A search this sweep returned 'the ITC final vote on Bulgaria, Egypt and Vietnam is expected in AUGUST 2026', which contradicts the mid-September date this repo carries and would have looked like a correction. IT IS A STALE PROJECTION. That August estimate was published when Commerce's finals were still expected earlier in July; Commerce actually determined on 28-Jul and published 30-Jul (FR 2026-15438 AD, 2026-15437 CVD). THE ITC'S FINAL INJURY DETERMINATION IS DUE WITHIN 45 DAYS OF COMMERCE'S FINAL, which from 30-Jul gives MID-TO-LATE SEPTEMBER. Confirmed by a source that states both the rule and the revised expectation. So the file was right and stays unchanged. NEW EVIDENCE ON WHICH WAY THE VOTE GOES, and it is the first this repo has had. ALGERIA WAS SEVERED FROM THE SAME PETITION AND THE ITC HAS ALREADY MADE AN AFFIRMATIVE FINAL INJURY DETERMINATION ON IT. Same petition, same domestic industry, same product, same injury analysis - a different country record, so it does not decide Vietnam, but it is materially better than no information. Calibration forecast #10 was scored a HIT on the reasoning that HPG has already traded a full quarter under ~122% provisional duties and still printed revenue +53%; an affirmative ITC vote is what that reasoning ASSUMED, so this does not disturb the score. NEW CONTEXT ON THE RATES: Vietnam's final margins are 128.53-136.57%, against BULGARIA 53.27% and EGYPT 34.20-52.73%. VIETNAM IS BY FAR THE MOST PENALISED OF THE THREE, at roughly 2.4x to 4x the others. That is worth holding when reading any 'rebar duties finalised' headline that treats the three countries as one event. federalregister.gov still returns proxy 403 from this environment, so the rate table itself remains unread - OPEN-DECISIONS item 17.

decision_45_2026_qd_ubnd.subject: 2026 land-price adjustment coefficient (he so K)
decision_45_2026_qd_ubnd.formula: K = K1 x K2 x K3; for 2026 K1 = 1 and K3 = 1, so K reduces to K2, set by project type
decision_45_2026_qd_ubnd.note: THIRD DATED REGULATION THIS WEEK FOUND IN FORCE WITH NO RECORD IN THIS REPO, AND THE SECOND EFFECTIVE 01-JUL-2026. HCMC issued Decision 45/2026/QD-UBND setting the 2026 land-price adjustment coefficient, effective 01-JULY-2026 under Resolution 254/2025, which required every province and city to publish a K coefficient by that date. IT HAS BEEN IN FORCE FOR A MONTH. Searching this repo for 'land-use fee', 'bang gia dat', 'he so K', 'Land Law' and '254/2025' returns ZERO HITS in assumptions.json and ZERO in monitoring-log.md. Lane 5 explicitly covers 'HCMC approvals, LAND-FEE/LEGAL CHANGES, developer bonds' and that lane item has never produced anything. THE PATTERN, THIRD TIME IN FOUR DAYS: HPG's half-year volume disclosure sat unlogged three weeks (found 28-Jul); Circular 25/2026/TT-NHNN sat unrecorded four weeks, EFFECTIVE 01-JUL (found 29-Jul); this, ALSO EFFECTIVE 01-JUL, was never recorded at all. THE 29-JUL LESSON SAID 'regulator gazettes now join recurring operating disclosures as dated catalysts to be checked on their own cadence' - AND IT DID NOT EXTEND, because it was written about SBV circulars and this is a MUNICIPAL land decision, a different regulator bearing on a different holding. A lesson scoped to the regulator that produced it does not generalise on its own. NOTE ALSO that two separate instruments took effect on the SAME DATE, 01-Jul-2026, and both were missed - that date should have been watched as a cluster. WHY IT BEARS ON THE BOOK. Land-use fee is the single largest cost input for a Vietnamese residential developer, and it is computed as the land price table multiplied by K. HCMC's NEW LAND PRICE TABLE took effect 01-JAN-2026, built on 'market principles' under the 2024 Land Law, raising land prices across most areas with the largest increases reported at EIGHT TIMES; central districts rose modestly while fast-developing areas in the merged Binh Duong and Ba Ria-Vung Tau units rose far more. KDH IS 20.3% OF THE BOOK with inventory above 23,000bn - land awaiting development - and Gladia and Clarita are exactly the kind of unlaunched or absorbing projects on which a land-use fee obligation crystallises. THE DIRECTION IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND THE OBVIOUS READING IS NOT TAKEN. 'Land prices up, therefore bad for developers' is available and this file is not taking it. Press frames Decision 45 as intended to THAO GO VUONG MAC - remove obstacles - in property procedures and in the financial obligations of individuals and businesses, because an unpublished K coefficient had itself been blocking valuations and approvals. So a higher table raises fees while a published K unblocks stalled process, and this file cannot net the two. WHAT IS NOT KNOWN, STATED SO IT IS NOT GUESSED: KDH's project-specific K2 values, and WHICH OF ITS PROJECTS HAVE ALREADY SETTLED THEIR LAND-USE FEE - fees are typically assessed at assignment or conversion, so projects already paid are unaffected regardless of the new table. Without both, any number put into the model would be invented. ESCALATED, NOT MODELLED: no branch, probability, weight or confidence touched.

circular_08_2026_tt_nhnn.subject: 20% of State Treasury TIME DEPOSITS countable as capital in the LDR calculation
circular_08_2026_tt_nhnn.note: FOURTH DATED REGULATION FOUND IN FORCE WITH NO RECORD IN THIS REPO, AND THE OLDEST YET - THREE MONTHS. Issued MAY 2026, it lets banks count 20% of State Treasury time deposits as capital when computing the LOAN-TO-DEPOSIT RATIO, expanding lending capacity. Zero hits for 'LDR', 'Circular 08' or '08/2026' anywhere in assumptions.json before this entry. IT RELAXES THE EXACT CONSTRAINT THIS FILE SPENT THE NIGHT FLAGGING. Within the last six hours this repo recorded that TCB's loans outgrew deposits 2.2x in H1 (10.4% vs 4.8%) and that MBB grew customer loans 13.2% YTD, and read both against the 31-Jul finding that interbank funding cost rose 30-59bp across July. THE IMPLIED WORRY WAS THAT THE FUNDING GAP WOULD BIND. Circular 08 loosens the ratio that would bind it. THE WORRY IS NOT WITHDRAWN - a looser ratio does not make funding cheaper, and the interbank price moved regardless, which is the same distinction drawn for Circular 25 on 31-Jul: A CIRCULAR RELAXES A RATIO, IT DOES NOT LOWER A PRICE. But the constraint is looser than the night's entries implicitly assumed, and that should be on the record beside them.

credit_quota_exemptions_2026.subject: Lending excluded from the credit room / real-estate credit for 2026
credit_quota_exemptions_2026.scope: 25 commercial banks may exclude additional social-housing, industrial-zone and EPZ lending from real-estate credit; 18 projects of 3 private economic groups excluded from the credit room
credit_quota_exemptions_2026.note: THIS NAMES THE MECHANISM BEHIND A GAP THIS FILE RESOLVED TWO HOURS AGO BY INFERENCE. At 03:53 the TCB credit-versus-loans question was settled using the company's own phrasing - standalone credit +14.3% 'INCLUDING INFRASTRUCTURE AND SOCIAL-HOUSING LOANS THAT ARE EXCLUDED FROM CREDIT LIMITS' against customer loans +10.4%. THE POLICY BEHIND THAT CLAUSE IS NOW IDENTIFIED AND DATED: SBV permits 25 commercial banks to exclude additional social-housing, industrial-zone and export-processing-zone lending, and has removed 18 projects of 3 private economic groups from the room entirely. An upgrade from a company's characterisation to a named instrument. AND IT BREAKS CROSS-BANK COMPARABILITY, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MATTERS. TCB reports TWO rates and says which is which. MBB reports customer loans +13.2% YTD. VPB reports parent credit +24.6%. THIS FILE DOES NOT KNOW WHICH OF THOSE CONTAIN QUOTA-EXEMPT LENDING AND WHICH DO NOT. Every cross-bank credit-growth comparison made this week - including 'MBB's version of VPB's problem is milder' - implicitly treated the rates as one comparable quantity. THEY ARE NOT NECESSARILY THE SAME MEASURE. That does not invalidate the per-bank H2 arithmetic, which was computed against each company's own reported base and its own branches; it invalidates comparing the three rates to each other. SCALE CONTEXT WORTH HOLDING: SBV projects SYSTEM credit growth of ~15% for 2026. Against that, MBB targets 30-35%, VPB's FY plan implies ~34% (962,000 -> 1.29 quadrillion) and TCB's branches are 16-20%. TWO OF THE THREE BANKS IN THIS BOOK PLAN TO GROW CREDIT AT MORE THAN TWICE THE SYSTEM RATE. Individual quotas vary by design and healthier banks get more, so this is not an objection - but it does mean both plans depend on continued preferential allocation or heavy use of exemptions, and neither dependency is modelled anywhere. A PERIOD TRAP DISARMED IN PASSING: the widely-circulated 'PRIME MINISTER ORDERS SBV TO PILOT REMOVING THE CREDIT ROOM FROM 2026' is dated AUGUST 2025, not now, and the pilot REMAINS UNDER DEVELOPMENT. A future sweep will find those articles and they are a year old.

circular_29_2026_tt_nhnn.subject: Amends Circular 39/2016/TT-NHNN on lending by credit institutions to customers
circular_29_2026_tt_nhnn.grandfathering: agreements signed before 15-Aug-2026 continue under the old rules; any amendment after that date must comply with the new ones
circular_29_2026_tt_nhnn.tier: T1/T2 instrument; substance from T5 press
circular_29_2026_tt_nhnn.note: THE FIRST REGULATION THIS REPO HAS FOUND BEFORE ITS EFFECTIVE DATE RATHER THAN AFTER, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF THE ENTRY. Circular 29/2026/TT-NHNN was ISSUED 30-JUN-2026 and takes effect 15-AUG-2026 - TWO WEEKS FROM NOW. Compare the four found in the past three days: Circular 25/2026 (four weeks late), HCMC Decision 45/2026 (one month), Circular 08/2026 (THREE months), and the credit-quota exemptions (undated). ALL FOUR WERE FOUND ONLY AFTER SOMETHING ELSE MADE THEM RELEVANT. THE BACK-SWEEP COMMITTED ONE HOUR AGO WAS RUN IMMEDIATELY AND THIS IS ITS FIRST RESULT. The lesson written at 06:53 was 'SBV and MoF circulars get a monthly back-sweep of the preceding quarter, not a search when a thesis needs one'. Running it once turned a pattern of retrospective discovery into a dated catalyst with two weeks of warning. That is the difference between writing a lesson and applying it, and it is recorded because the previous four show what the alternative costs. WHAT IT CHANGES, AS FAR AS IS ESTABLISHED. Three named areas: DEBT-HANDLING PROCEDURES, SMALL-VALUE LOAN LIMITS, and THE LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR ELECTRONIC LENDING. Small-value loans are now quantified, at not more than 200,000,000 VND for people's credit funds - a threshold that does not touch our banks directly. Agreements signed before 15-Aug run on under the old rules, but ANY AMENDMENT after that date must comply with the new ones, so the transition reaches existing books through restructurings. WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND IS NOT GUESSED. The amendments are known by ARTICLE NUMBER (Art.1 cl.3, Art.2 cl.13, Art.8 cl.6(b), Art.18 cl.4, Art.22 cl.2(h)) and by press characterisation, NOT by text - thuvienphapluat's full-text page returns proxy 403, the SIXTH host to refuse this session. Article 8 of Circular 39 is the list of purposes credit institutions may NOT lend for, so an amendment there is potentially the most consequential of the five, BUT THIS FILE HAS NOT READ IT and will not infer its content from its location. One outlet headlines the circular as good news for borrowers; whether that is neutral, positive or negative for LENDER margins is a different question and is unanswered. WHY IT PLAUSIBLY MATTERS HERE, STATED AS A REASON TO WATCH RATHER THAN A FINDING: the three areas are retail and consumer lending, and this book holds VPB (which contains FE CREDIT), MBB (which contains MCREDIT) and TCB, 51.5% between them. The electronic-lending framework is the piece most likely to matter to a digital-first lender. NOTHING MODELLED, no confidence moved, no branch touched.

_regulatory._THE_SOURCE_THAT_MAKES_THE_BACK_SWEEP_RE: MORE USEFUL THAN ANY SINGLE CIRCULAR: A RECURRING SOURCE WITH A PREDICTABLE CADENCE. luatvietnam publishes a monthly digest titled 'Chinh sach moi ve tai chinh ngan hang hieu luc thang [N]/2026' - NEW FINANCE AND BANKING POLICIES TAKING EFFECT IN MONTH N. It is forward-looking by construction, which is exactly what every one of this week's four late catches lacked. FIVE MISSED OR LATE REGULATIONS IN FOUR DAYS SHARE ONE CAUSE: the lanes hunt for things that HAPPENED, and a circular gazetted on a known date never 'happens' in that sense. The fix is not a better search query, it is a SOURCE WITH A CALENDAR. Recorded here so the next sweep does not have to rediscover the method along with the content. Also worth checking on the same cadence: NHNN publishes an annual programme of the circulars it intends to issue - 18 for 2026, seven of them planned for Q2 - which makes the pipeline itself checkable in advance rather than only the output. ALSO FLAGGED, NOT PURSUED THIS SWEEP: Circular 20/2026/TT-BTC guides the Corporate Income Tax Law and Decree 320/2025. This model assumes a 20% effective CIT throughout - MBB's Q1 checks at exactly 0.80 NPAT/PBT - so a CIT guidance change would touch ALL EIGHT names at once rather than one sector. NOT READ, and no tax assumption has been altered on the basis of a title.

circular_31_2026_tt_nhnn.subject: Financial leasing by GENERAL finance companies and FINANCIAL LEASING companies; replaces Circular 26/2024/TT-NHNN
circular_31_2026_tt_nhnn.change: brings PROPERTY RIGHTS - software, data, exploitation rights, intellectual property - into the list of assets eligible for financial leasing
circular_31_2026_tt_nhnn.tier: T5 press on a gazetted circular
circular_31_2026_tt_nhnn.note: SECOND SBV INSTRUMENT EFFECTIVE 15-AUG-2026, WHICH CONFIRMS THAT DATE AS A CLUSTER. Circular 29/2026 (lending) was logged an hour ago on the same effective date. The 31-Jul lesson that EFFECTIVE DATES CLUSTER - written after 01-Jul turned out to carry both Circular 25/2026 and HCMC Decision 45/2026 - now has a second instance, and this time the cluster is FOURTEEN DAYS AHEAD rather than a month behind. SCOPE CHECKED, AND IT RESOLVES NEGATIVE, WHICH IS THE USEFUL ANSWER. The circular governs 'cong ty tai chinh TONG HOP' (GENERAL finance companies) and 'cong ty cho thue tai chinh' (FINANCIAL LEASING companies). This book reaches two finance companies through its banks: FE CREDIT (VPB) and MCREDIT (MBB). Both appear to be CONSUMER finance companies rather than general or leasing ones - MCredit's legal name is 'Cong ty Tai chinh TIN DUNG TIEU DUNG TNHH MB Shinsei', consumer credit written into the name itself, and FE Credit is 'Cong ty Tai chinh TNHH MTV Ngan hang Viet Nam Thinh Vuong', whose business descends directly from VPBank's consumer credit division. _regulatory._THE_THREE_BANK_STOCK_ISSUES_ARE_NOT_THE: THE SET IS COMPLETE AND THE ANSWER IS COUNTERINTUITIVE. After pinning VPB's label an hour ago, the same check was run on the other two flags written in the same form - the 29-Jul lesson that when one stale flag is found, every other flag of the same shape gets checked in the same sweep. ALL THREE ARE NOW PINNED AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME INSTRUMENT. TCB 60%, over 4.28bn shares, charter capital +42,876bn: BONUS SHARES ISSUED FROM OWNER'S EQUITY (co phieu thuong). A capital restructuring, NOT a dividend distribution. Separately its 7% cash (4,960bn) IS from undistributed profit and is a real dividend. VPB 26.04%, 2.06bn shares: STOCK DIVIDEND FROM RETAINED EARNINGS, amended in July from an owner's-equity bonus issue approved at the 22-Apr AGM. MBB 15%, over 1.2bn shares, 12,082bn: STOCK DIVIDEND FROM UNDISTRIBUTED ACCUMULATED PROFIT of 21,234bn at 31-Dec-2025, part of a 25% total distribution worth 20,137bn of which 8,055bn is the 10% cash. SO THE LARGEST OF THE THREE STOCK ISSUES IS THE ONE THAT IS NOT A TAXABLE DISTRIBUTION, AND THE TWO SMALLER ONES ARE. That is the opposite of what 'TCB is paying 67%' suggests, and it is exactly the distinction that disappears when all three are recorded as 'a big stock issue pending'. SIZED ON THE FILE'S OWN TAX_DIVIDEND = 0.05, par basis, at on-file prices: TCB 0.12% of price (cash only), VPB 0.62%, MBB 0.57%. Weighted by position that is 0.042 / 0.062 / 0.037pp, TOTALLING 0.141pp OF THE WHOLE BOOK from three names that are 51.5% of it. THREE CAVEATS, STATED BECAUSE THE NUMBER LOOKS MORE SOLID THAN IT IS. (1) Vietnamese PIT on stock dividends is generally COLLECTED ON DISPOSAL, not at issuance, so this is a DEFERRED liability rather than a current cost - it reduces realised proceeds whenever the holder sells, which for a long-term holder may be years away. (2) The 5% rate is the file's own assumption in cfa.py and has NOT been verified against current law this sweep; the draft MoF decree carried as TAX_GAINS_DRAFT = 0.20 shows the regime is in flux. (3) Prices are the undated ones OPEN-DECISIONS item 2 already flags. WHAT IT ADDS TO ITEM 3: that item asks a human to set a cash_yield convention. This repo already applies a 2.0x cap - VCI's note reads 'margin 16,644 / 0.97 = equity 17,159' against 'a 2.0x cap', and VPX's derives 'ceiling >=71,177 => equity >=35,588' from it. NEITHER NAMED THE INSTRUMENT. It is CIRCULAR 121/2020/TT-BTC: total margin debt of a securities company may not exceed 200% OF OWNER'S EQUITY. Per-stock lending ratios run 10-50% depending on the ticker, under Decision 87/QD-UBCK (2017). 'Margin rules 91/102' is named in the lane definition and returns ZERO hits in this repo; the binding instrument is 121/2020, so the lane text may be pointing at the wrong circulars. AND HERE IS WHAT WAS NEVER COMPUTED: TCBS'S OWN UTILISATION. On this file's figures - TCX market cap pe_ttm 20.3 x npat_ttm 4,050 = 82,215bn, at P/B 2.49 - implied EQUITY is ~33,018bn, so the regulatory ceiling is ~66,036bn. TCBS'S MARGIN BOOK OF 51,500bn IS THEREFORE ~1.56x EQUITY, OR 78% OF THE REGULATORY CAP, with headroom of roughly 14,500bn. THE THREE BROKERS SIT AT VERY DIFFERENT UTILISATIONS AND THE FILE HAD ONLY LOOKED AT TWO: VCI 0.97x, VPX ~1.07x, TCBS ~1.56x. THE FILE HAS CRITICISED VCI FOR NOT USING ITS CAPACITY - 'unused capacity that stays unused in the best conditions on record is a description of the business, not an option on it' - and has treated VPX's >33,000bn of unused room as its REAL BULL CASE, better than the CAEX option. IT NEVER NOTICED THAT TCX IS THE ONE ACTUALLY LEVERED. WHICH REFRAMES THE TCX CASE WITHOUT CONTRADICTING IT. TCX ranks first on expected return and earns ~31% of H1 PBT from margin interest on that 51,500bn book. Those earnings come from a balance sheet that is MORE THAN THREE QUARTERS DRAWN AGAINST ITS REGULATORY LIMIT, so the margin line cannot grow much faster than equity does. The same fact that makes VCI look inert makes TCX look constrained - and neither reading was available while only two of the three were measured. NOTE WHAT DOES NOT RELIEVE IT: TCB's 60% BONUS ISSUE MOVES RESERVES INTO CHARTER CAPITAL AND DOES NOT INCREASE TOTAL OWNER'S EQUITY - and in any case it is the PARENT's equity, not TCBS's. Capacity at TCBS moves on retained earnings or a capital injection, neither of which is on file. STATED WITH ITS CAVEAT: TCX's equity here is DERIVED from pe_ttm x npat_ttm / P/B, not read from a balance sheet, and npat_ttm cross-checks have already failed twice in this repo (VCI 25.2% off, VPX 9-27% off). SO 1.56x IS AN ESTIMATE BUILT ON FILE FIGURES, NOT A FILED NUMBER. It is directionally robust - TCBS would need equity above 25,750bn merely to be legal at 51,500bn - but the precise utilisation needs TCBS's reported equity. ESCALATED, NOT MODELLED.

_regulatory._THE_FIRST_MOIT_INSTRUMENT_IN_THIS_FILE_: SEVENTH INSTANCE OF THE LATE-REGULATION SPECIES, AND THE ONE THAT SHOULD STING MOST. Decision 612/QD-BCT has been IN FORCE SINCE 17-APR-2026 - three and a half months - and there is no record of it anywhere in this repo: zero hits for 'kho rong', 'wide-format', '1880', 'lo hong thue' or 'loophole' in either the log or this file. WHY IT SHOULD HAVE BEEN CAUGHT: the 31-JUL calibration lesson, written after the FOURTH such miss, said the fix was to 'name the regulators per holding rather than the category' and named them explicitly - 'SBV and MoF for the banks and brokers, HCMC/provincial People's Committees and MoNRE for KDH, MoIT and USITC/Commerce for HPG'. THIS BLOCK NOW CONTAINS THIRTEEN INSTRUMENTS AND UNTIL THIS ENTRY NOT ONE OF THEM WAS FROM MoIT. The lesson named the regulator and no sweep ever queried it. The monthly back-sweep that was set up covers SBV/MoF gazettes via luatvietnam's banking-finance digest, which by construction cannot surface a trade-defence decision. WHAT THE MEASURE IS. Vietnam already levied 23.01-27.83% anti-dumping duty on Chinese HRC of width below 1,880mm. Chinese exporters shifted to WIDE format - 1,880-2,300mm - which fell outside the scope. Wide HRC imports from China ran ~650,000t in H1/2025, ABOUT 15 TIMES the prior-year period. NOTE THE PERIOD: that is H1/2025, a YEAR OLD, and the current run-rate is NOT established here. Hoa Phat and Formosa Ha Tinh petitioned MoIT; the preliminary investigation found circumvention through 'insignificant modification of goods already subject to trade defence measures'; Decision 612 applies 27.83% to the wide band across 24 HS codes, excluding carbon above 0.30% and plate 10mm or thicker. IT IS TEMPORARY, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MATTERS FORWARD. 'Thue tam thoi' - a provisional measure - so a FINAL determination is still to come and is A DATED CATALYST THIS FILE DOES NOT CARRY. Its date is not established here. HPG IS A PETITIONER, NOT A BYSTANDER, so this is also a governance/positioning fact about the company. AND THE HONEST READING CUTS AGAINST THE OBVIOUS ONE. The naive read is 'protection granted, domestic HRC prices supported, bullish for the spread'. THE PRICE EVIDENCE ON FILE SAYS OTHERWISE. Three months AFTER the duty took effect, domestic HRC was still falling under import pressure - a 13-JUL report has domestic HRC down with import competition INCREASING - and HPG then cut its own August offer by ~US$34/t with Formosa cutting ~US$40/t across August-September. SO THE MEASURE CLOSED A CHANNEL; IT DID NOT HOLD THE PRICE. Both facts are true at once and the file should carry both. NOTHING MODELLED - no trade-policy input exists in the spread bridge, and the bridge's HRC input is already pinned to HPG's own offer, which prices this measure in by construction.

_regulatory._THE_INDIA_TERMINATION_IS_THE_MECHANISM_: RAN THE MoIT BACK-SWEEP CREATED ONE HOUR AGO. IT IMMEDIATELY PRODUCED THREE MORE INSTRUMENTS, ALL ABSENT FROM THIS REPO, AND ONE OF THEM EXPLAINS THE 14:53 FINDING RATHER THAN ADDING TO IT. THE 14:53 PUZZLE WAS: a 27.83% anti-circumvention duty took effect 17-Apr-2026 and domestic HRC KEPT FALLING under rising import competition, with HPG cutting its August offer ~US$34/t. The entry concluded 'the measure closed a channel; it did not hold the price' and could not say why. NOW IT CAN. DECISION 1959/QD-BCT, 04-JUL-2025, DID TWO THINGS IN ONE DOCUMENT. It imposed the OFFICIAL Chinese HRC anti-dumping duty of up to 27.83% FOR FIVE YEARS - running to roughly 04-JUL-2030 unless replaced, extended or revoked, which is long-dated support this file did not have - AND IT TERMINATED THE INVESTIGATION INTO INDIAN HRC. THE REASON FOR THE INDIA TERMINATION IS THE PART THAT MATTERS AND IT IS NOT 'INDIA WAS FOUND NOT TO BE DUMPING'. The investigation was terminated because Indian imports during the investigation period were LESS THAN 3% OF TOTAL IMPORT VOLUME - the de minimis NEGLIGIBILITY threshold. That is a VOLUME test, and it was measured over a DATED window (the AD20 investigation period, case initiated July 2024). SO THE IMPORT CHANNEL THAT REMAINS OPEN IS INDIA'S, AND THIS FILE HAS BEEN CARRYING EVIDENCE OF IT WITHOUT THE EXPLANATION. 'Indian landed at 535' was logged as spread bear-evidence on 26-Jul and the file never knew Indian HRC carries NO anti-dumping duty at all. Chinese HRC: 27.83% for five years, plus the wide-format route closed 17-Apr-2026. Indian HRC: nothing. THAT IS THE MECHANISM - the ministry closed the Chinese channel and, in the same document a year earlier, explicitly left the Indian one open. AND IT CREATES A FORWARD ITEM, STATED WITH ITS UNCERTAINTY. The termination rests on a threshold that is volume-dependent and dated. IF Indian volumes have since risen above 3% of imports, the ground for termination has eroded and a fresh petition becomes possible - and HPG is already a proven petitioner, twice. WHETHER INDIAN VOLUMES NOW EXCEED 3% IS NOT ESTABLISHED HERE AND IS NOT ASSUMED. This is recorded as a mechanism to watch, not as a prediction. The cheap check is Indian HRC's share of Vietnamese HRC imports in 2026. A TRAP DISARMED BY INTERNAL LOGIC RATHER THAN BY COUNTING SOURCES. One source gives the wide-format band as 1,800-2,300mm; the others give 1,880-2,300mm. THE UNDERLYING DUTY COVERS WIDTHS BELOW 1,880mm, so an anti-circumvention band starting at 1,800mm would OVERLAP the existing measure by 80mm, which is incoherent - an anti-circumvention measure exists precisely to catch what falls OUTSIDE the original scope. 1,880 IS RIGHT AND 1,800 IS A TYPO. Note the method: the majority-of-sources heuristic would have reached the same answer here, but the logical test is the one that would still work if the typo had been the majority. NOTHING MODELLED; no confidence moved. No model input changed - the bridge's HRC input is HPG's own offer, which embeds all of this by construction.

_regulatory._A_NEGATIVE_RESULT_I_RECORDED_TO_STOP_FU: THE WORST CLASS OF ERROR THIS SYSTEM CAN MAKE, BECAUSE IT DOES NOT MERELY MISS SOMETHING - IT INSTALLS A BLOCKER AGAINST FINDING IT. WHAT I WROTE ON 31-JUL, VERBATIM: 'Lane 2 checked and clean: the corrosion-resistant steel (CORE) case on Vietnam ran its course in 2024-25 ... and NO NEW VIETNAM STEEL PETITION OR CORE REVIEW HAS BEEN FILED IN 2026. Recorded as a negative result SO THE NEXT SWEEP DOES NOT RE-SEARCH IT.' WHAT WAS ALREADY TRUE WHEN I WROTE IT: STEEL DYNAMICS AND NUCOR FILED A CIRCUMVENTION REQUEST ON 02-FEB-2026 AND COMMERCE INITIATED THE INQUIRY ON 25-MAR-2026, published at 91 FR 14530. THE NEGATIVE RESULT WAS FIVE MONTHS STALE ON THE DAY IT WAS RECORDED, AND ITS EXPLICIT PURPOSE WAS TO SUPPRESS THE SEARCH THAT WOULD HAVE FOUND IT. It worked: three days of sweeps did not re-check lane 2. AND THE ROOT CAUSE IS THE ONE DIAGNOSED TWO HOURS AGO. federalregister.gov IS BLOCKED AT THE GATEWAY - RE-TESTED THIS SWEEP, still 403 connect_rejected. THAT IS LANE 2's AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE. So lane 2 has been running on press coverage alone, and 'nothing in the press' was written down as 'nothing filed'. THAT IS EXACTLY THE CONFLATION NAMED AT 15:53 - 'I could not find it' versus 'I could not reach it' - AND HERE IT HAD ALREADY PRODUCED A FALSE NEGATIVE THAT WAS RECORDED AS A BLOCKER THREE DAYS BEFORE THE DISTINCTION WAS DRAWN. The 15:53 lesson is not new; it is the diagnosis of damage already done. WHAT THE INQUIRY ACTUALLY IS, AND IT IS A DIFFERENT EXPOSURE FROM THE ONE THIS FILE TRACKS. Not Vietnamese finished exports being dumped. THE ALLEGATION IS THAT CORE IS COMPLETED IN INDONESIA USING COLD-ROLLED STEEL MANUFACTURED IN VIETNAM, and thereby circumvents the AD/CVD orders on CORE FROM VIETNAM. THE SUBJECT INPUT IS VIETNAMESE SUBSTRATE. This file's US exposure for HPG is direct rebar at about 3% of revenue; THIS IS A SUBSTRATE CHANNEL AND IT WAS NOT ON FILE AT ALL. HPG is Vietnam's largest flat-steel producer and cold-rolled coil is squarely inside the DQ2 product set. WHETHER HPG'S CRC IS IN THE ALLEGED TRADE FLOW IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT GUESSED - Commerce's inquiry is COUNTRY-WIDE, names no Vietnamese producer, and the mechanism is recorded without a conclusion about the company. THE DATE, AND IT IS CLOSE. COMMERCE INTENDS PRELIMINARY CIRCUMVENTION DETERMINATIONS BY 24-AUG-2026 - TWENTY-ONE DAYS. That puts THREE dated items in August that bear on this book: 14-Aug and 29-Aug H1 auditor-REVIEWED statements, the 15-Aug SBV circular cluster, and now 24-Aug. Extensions are routine in circumvention proceedings, so 24-Aug is an INTENTION, not a guarantee, and is recorded as one. THE MAGNITUDES ARE PROHIBITIVE, WHICH CHANGES THE SHAPE OF THE RISK. Existing Vietnam CORE rates are AD 87.07-162.96% and CVD 0.30-257.83%. An affirmative finding attaches those to the Indonesian-finished product. AT THOSE LEVELS A TRADE FLOW STOPS RATHER THAN SHRINKS, so the outcome is closer to binary than to marginal - which is why the SIZE of any HPG participation matters more than the probability of the finding. THE CHINA PARALLEL, LABELLED AS SECOND-ORDER. FR 2026-05807 runs the same inquiry on CHINESE hot- and cold-rolled substrate into Indonesia. This file's 02-Aug work established that CHINESE AND INDIAN HRC COMPETING INTO VIETNAM is HPG's live domestic problem. A US measure closing an Indonesian outlet for Chinese substrate would push that material to look for other destinations, plausibly including Vietnam. THAT IS AN INFERENCE ABOUT REDIRECTED TRADE FLOWS WITH NO EVIDENCE BEHIND IT YET AND IT IS NOT MODELLED. CONFIDENCE ON HPG HELD AT 0.75, AND THE REASONING IS STATED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. Confidence measures how well evidenced the THESIS is, and the thesis is the volume-x-spread model, which the FILED Q2 actuals support. This is a Layer-4 trade-politics channel outside the model whose magnitude for HPG is UNQUANTIFIED. Cutting confidence on an unquantified exposure would substitute alarm for evidence. FLAGGED EXPLICITLY FOR THE HUMAN CIO RUN INSTEAD, which is where a Layer-4 judgment belongs.

THE FILE HAS CARRIED '18 PROJECTS OF 3 PRIVATE ECONOMIC GROUPS EXCLUDED FROM THE CREDIT ROOM' AS AN UNNAMED FACT. THE THREE GROUPS ARE VINGROUP, SUN GROUP AND MASTERISE. One of them is the subject of an ARMED KILL CRITERION on the largest position in this book.

THE INSTRUMENT, AND A CONFLATION DISARMED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN DOWN. The search result that surfaced this said the exclusion was granted BY CIRCULAR 25/2026/TT-NHNN. IT WAS NOT. Circular 25 amends Circular 22/2019 on prudential limits and safety ratios - that is what this file's own T1 entry on it says, and credit-room allocation is not made under Circular 22. The actual vehicle is CONG VAN 5386/NHNN-TD, an SBV guidance letter to commercial banks. ITS DATE IS 22-JUN-2026 - THE SAME DAY CIRCULAR 25 WAS ISSUED, which is almost certainly why press and search summaries merge them. TWO INSTRUMENTS, ONE DAY, DIFFERENT LEGAL WEIGHT: a thong tu is a normative legal document; a cong van is administrative guidance, weaker and far more easily withdrawn. Anything that depends on this carve-out depends on a letter, not on law.

WHAT THE EXCLUSION ACTUALLY COVERS, and this is wider than 'the room'. Newly incurred debt on the approved projects is excluded from (1) ANNUAL CREDIT GROWTH - the room; (2) THE SHORT-TERM-FUNDING-FOR-MEDIUM-AND-LONG-TERM-LENDING RATIO - the very ratio Circular 25 raised from 30% to 40% the same day; and (3) THE SINGLE-CUSTOMER AND RELATED-CUSTOMER-GROUP CREDIT LIMIT. (3) IS THE SHARPEST ITEM AND THE FILE HAD NO VERSION OF IT. The room is a GROWTH guardrail; the single-borrower limit is a CONCENTRATION guardrail, and concentration is precisely the risk this book has been circling on TCB for two weeks. Lending banks must monitor the excluded debt separately and report it to SBV, so the supervisory data exists - it is simply not public.

SCALE. Total mobilisation need across the 18 projects is about 752,138bn, phased 210,047bn in 2026, 244,188bn in 2027 and 187,018bn in 2028. NO SHARE-OF-SYSTEM-CREDIT RATIO IS COMPUTED HERE: mobilisation need is not the same quantity as bank credit drawn, and dividing one by the other would manufacture a precision the source does not support. Named projects include APEC conference facilities, the Rach Chiec international sports complex, the Ben Thanh - Can Gio railway and the Ha Noi - Quang Ninh railway. THESE ARE INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT APARTMENTS.

THE ENTITY CHECK, WHICH CUTS AGAINST THE CONVENIENT READING. The Masterise applicant is named as CTCP HA TANG HANG KHONG MASTERISE - Masterise AVIATION INFRASTRUCTURE. That is not Masterise Homes, and it is not any of the six property issuers behind the 44,500bn of H1 bonds recorded on 28-Jul and 31-Jul. So this does NOT connect the quota carve-out to the property-bond refinancing wall, and the tempting sentence - 'banks can now refinance Masterise projects with quota-free loans instead of 11.5-12% bonds' - IS NOT SUPPORTED AND IS NOT WRITTEN. If anything it makes item 27 WORSE: TCB's armed test says 'a Masterise bond event', the 31-Jul entry already found the boundary of 'Masterise' was not crisp, and the state has now applied the name to an aviation-infrastructure company. THE BOUNDARY GOT WIDER, NOT TIGHTER. Evidence status on a held name changed; NO CRITERION IS DECLARED FIRED.

TCB'S EXPOSURE TO ANY OF THESE PROJECTS OR ISSUERS IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT INFERRED. The sources name the borrowers and do not name the lenders. This file refused this exact link on 02-Aug (KDH's bond violations to the TCB/Masterise finding) and again on 04-Aug ('the link between the two halves is the thing still missing, and naming it as missing is not the same as supplying it'). THE REFUSAL STANDS UNCHANGED.

WHAT IT DOES BEAR ON, HONESTLY. (a) ON THE BANKS, 51.5% of book: the file's circular_25 entry credited a SYSTEM-WIDE SMLR loosening with making VPB's and MBB's H2 credit targets more achievable. That reading needs a qualifier - part of the same day's loosening is a NAMED ALLOCATION to three private groups, exempt from three constraints at once. Preferential capacity that is allocated by name is not capacity available to everyone. It does not reverse the earlier point; it narrows it. (b) ON KDH, 20.3% of book: KDH is a developer and is NOT one of the three. Three competitors for bank balance-sheet capacity now borrow outside the room, outside the SMLR ratio and outside the concentration limit; KDH borrows inside all three, with its land bank fully pledged and debt up 51% to 15.3tn. THIS IS A RELATIVE DISADVANTAGE, NOT AN ABSOLUTE ONE, and it is not sized.

NOTHING MODELLED. No probability, branch, weight or confidence moved. Charter s5: bears on theses, not on numbers.

HOW THIS WAS MISSED, AND IT IS THE THIRD TIME. Dated 22-Jun, in the Vietnamese press on 23-Jun with the names in the HEADLINES, and this file recorded the ANONYMISED version instead. That is worse than the Circular 25 miss and the HPG half-year-volume miss, because in both of those the file held NOTHING. Here it held a PARTIAL record that read as complete: 'three private economic groups' looks like a fact rather than like a gap. AN ANONYMISED FACT IN A FILE FULL OF NAMED ONES IS A MISSING SEARCH WEARING THE COSTUME OF A FINISHED ONE.
_regulatory.sbv_july_credit_print_and_the_220tn_pack:
THE GATED ITEM LANDED, AND IT LANDED TWO DAYS BEFORE THE GATE SAID IT WOULD.

THE PRINT (T2, Deputy Governor Pham Thanh Ha at the regular GOVERNMENT PRESS CONFERENCE, 03-AUG-2026). SYSTEM CREDIT OUTSTANDING 20,150,000bn AS AT 29-JUL-2026, +8.38% ON END-2025. Credit structure directed to production/business and government priority sectors. Credit is still growing faster than deposits and the gap remains large. 7M CPI average 4.39% - EXACTLY the figure this file already holds, so that half is a confirmation, not news.

THE GATE WAS MIS-DATED AND THE MISS IS THE FINDING. The monitoring-log row created at 04-Aug 22:53 reads 'SBV monthly credit/deposit prints - DUE ~05-AUG, TOMORROW', derived from a 'month-end +5d' rule. THE PRINT CAME ON 03-AUG VIA THE GOVERNMENT PRESS CONFERENCE, not on a statistical calendar. A GATE PLACED IN THE FUTURE FOR AN EVENT ALREADY IN THE PAST IS WORSE THAN NO GATE: it actively suppressed the search for two days, because a dated row that says 'not before 05-Aug' reads as a decision already taken. The 03-Aug sweeps were busy with the CPI/PMI quadruple date and this landed the same day, in the same press conference cycle, unlooked-for.

THE ARITHMETIC, AND IT IS NOT WHAT THE HEADLINE SUGGESTS. Three dated points now exist: END-JUN +7.73%, 13-JUL +7.86%, 29-JUL +8.38%. Against a 15% FY path the linear requirement is 0.0411pp/day. H1 RAN 0.0427pp/day - 104% of it, on pace. 30-JUN to 13-JUL RAN 0.0100pp/day - 24%. 13-JUL to 29-JUL RAN 0.0325pp/day - 79%. FULL JULY 0.0224pp/day - 55%. SO JULY HALVED THE PACE AND THE LAST FORTNIGHT RECOVERED MOST OF THE WAY BACK. The remaining requirement is 6.62pp over 155 days = 0.0427pp/day, WHICH IS 1.91x JULY'S ACTUAL PACE. STATED WITH ITS LIMIT: Vietnamese credit is heavily Q4-weighted, so being behind a LINEAR path in July is normal and this file has NO prior-year monthly path to say how normal. THIS IS ARITHMETIC, NOT A FORECAST MISS - and it is the honest version of a headline that reads as straightforward acceleration.

NEW AND NOT ON FILE: A 220,000bn PREFERENTIAL CREDIT PACKAGE REGISTERED BY THE FOUR STATE-OWNED COMMERCIAL BANKS, for SMEs and government priority sectors, at preferential rates, with SBV guidelines to follow 'in the coming days'. SIZED AGAINST THE PRINT: on the derived end-2025 base of ~18,592,000bn, a 15% year needs ~2,788,800bn of growth, ~1,558,000bn is delivered, and ~1,230,800bn remains. 220,000bn IS 17.9% OF THE CREDIT GROWTH STILL REQUIRED THIS YEAR, allocated to four banks that are NOT in this book, priced below market. THE MECHANISM THAT MATTERS HERE IS COMPETITIVE, NOT MACRO: a subsidised competitor in the SME and priority segments is a price headwind for private banks lending to the same borrowers. VPB IS THE MOST EXPOSED IN PRINCIPLE - it positions itself as an SME bank - and MBB carries an SME franchise too. NOT SIZED, AND THAT IS THE POINT: this file holds NO segment split of VPB's or MBB's loan book, so the exposure is a direction with no magnitude. NOTE ALSO THE COMPOSITION EFFECT ON THE SYSTEM NUMBER ITSELF: if a sixth of the remaining growth is policy-allocated to four banks, the system aggregate becomes a weaker proxy for what a private bank can grow at - which is the SAME comparability problem the credit_quota_exemptions entry already raised, arriving now from the other direction.

A DUPLICATE CAUGHT BEFORE IT WAS LOGGED, AND AN AMBIGUITY THE FILE SHOULD OWN. The coverage says 'the ratio of State Treasury deposits at commercial banks rose from 20% to 50%, effective 01-Aug-2026 to 31-Jul-2028'. THAT IS ALREADY ON FILE as ldr_treasury_deduction_cut_2026_08_01 - same 20-to-50, same two-year window - so it is NOT a new instrument and was not logged as one. BUT THE TWO DESCRIPTIONS ARE NOT THE SAME CLAIM. The file says the LDR DEDUCTION on Treasury term deposits fell 80%->50%, so the share COUNTING toward the deposit base rose 20%->50% - a RATIO RELIEF, no new money. Two press sources now say the share of Treasury money PLACED at commercial banks rose 20%->50% - A LIQUIDITY INJECTION, real cash moving onto bank balance sheets. THE EFFECT SIZES ARE ENTIRELY DIFFERENT AND AT MOST ONE READING IS RIGHT. The file's own entry already flagged that it could not establish whether this amends Circular 08 or is separate; that uncertainty is now sharper, not resolved. RECORDED AS OPEN.

NOTHING MODELLED, AND THE REASON IS SYMMETRIC WITH A PRECEDENT. The circular_25 entry declined to RAISE confidence on a favourable environment, on the ground that 'a better environment for a figure we cannot verify is not better evidence for that figure'. The same logic forbids CUTTING confidence for an adverse one. No probability, branch, weight or confidence moved.
_regulatory._THE_MOIT_BACK_SWEEP_RAN_AT_LAST_AND_THE:
THE MoIT / TRADE-DEFENCE BACK-SWEEP, CREATED 02-AUG AND NEVER RUN, RAN THIS SWEEP. It answers item (a) of its own charter - 'the FINAL determination on wide-format HRC (612 is TEMPORARY) - date unknown'.

THE STATUTORY CLOCK, WHICH IS THE FINDING. Vietnamese trade-defence investigations must conclude within NINE MONTHS OF INITIATION, EXTENDABLE BY UP TO THREE MONTHS in special cases. This investigation was INITIATED 27-OCT-2025. NINE MONTHS FROM THAT IS 27-JULY-2026 - WHICH HAS ALREADY PASSED, NINE DAYS AGO - AND NO FINAL CONCLUSION HAS BEEN ISSUED. THE OUTER BOUND IS THEREFORE 27-OCTOBER-2026. So the case is in its extension window, or a final was issued and not found; the second is possible and is not assumed. A PROCEDURAL STEP ALSO SURFACED AND WAS NOT ON FILE: the Trade Remedies Authority held its PUBLIC CONSULTATION HEARING ON 03-JULY-2026, at which Hoa Phat and Formosa participated and the Chinese respondents argued the grounds were insufficient. A hearing 24 days before the ordinary deadline is the shape of a final being prepared for late July and then extended.

WHY THIS MATTERS FOR A FILE THAT ALREADY HELD DECISION 612 IN FULL DETAIL. The existing entry records 24 HS codes, four exempt grades, the width band, the carbon and thickness exclusions and the 650,000t circumvention volume - AND IT RECORDS THE MEASURE AS THOUGH IT WERE A SETTLED FEATURE OF HPG'S OPERATING ENVIRONMENT. IT IS NOT. The word TEMPORARY was in the entry from the start and nothing in the file attached a date to it. A 27.83% duty protecting 16.8% of the book now has a dated outer bound and a LAPSED ordinary one.

THE OPEN SUB-QUESTION, AND IT IS THE SHARPER HALF: THE TEMPORARY MEASURE'S OWN EXPIRY IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Decision 612 states it takes effect 15 days after issue (17-Apr-2026) and, per the coverage, DOES NOT STATE A TERM. IF a temporary anti-circumvention duty runs a fixed period shorter than the extended investigation window, THERE IS AN INTERVAL WITH NO PROTECTION AND A CASE STILL OPEN. NO TERM IS INVENTED HERE. What is established: effective 17-Apr, ordinary investigation deadline 27-Jul (passed), outer deadline 27-Oct. What is not: whether the duty survives to the outer deadline unaided.

AND THE SCOPE GAP THAT BEARS DIRECTLY ON OPEN ITEM 6. Decision 612 covers CHINA ONLY, and only widths 1,880-2,300mm. ITEM 6's whole argument for a spot_persists branch is that INDIAN HRC is entering Vietnam duty-free - the 2025 India anti-dumping case was terminated on a <3%-of-imports negligibility test - after the EU cut India's quota by ~34% and made Vietnam its largest destination. 612 DOES NOTHING ABOUT THAT CHANNEL. So HPG's headline protection and the competitive pressure the file has identified as the reason for spot to persist are ABOUT DIFFERENT COUNTRIES, and reading 612 as a general shield would be a category error. This does not weaken item 6; it removes an implicit offset that was never stated but would have been reached for.

NOT SIZED, DELIBERATELY. The circumvention volume is ~650,000t in H1/2025, ~15x year-on-year - roughly 1.3m tonnes annualised. This file holds HPG's TOTAL Q1 volume (3.0m t) but NOT its HRC-specific volume, so the displaced imports cannot be expressed as a share of HPG's HRC book without inventing the denominator. Stated as a volume, not as a share.

NOTHING MODELLED, AND THE TRIGGER CALL IS MADE EXPLICITLY. This is a change in what the file knows about a POLICY INPUT, not about HPG's earnings evidence: no branch, probability, price or confidence moved, and hpg.evidence is untouched. It therefore does NOT fire escalation trigger 4, on the same reasoning the circular_25 entry used to decline a confidence RAISE - a change in the operating environment is not evidence about a forecast. Recorded as a dated gate instead.
_regulatory._THE_CREDIT_QUOTA_LANE_HAD_ZERO_COVERAGE: THE CREDIT-QUOTA LANE IS NAMED IN THE ROUTINE AND HAS ZERO COVERAGE IN THIS FILE. FIXED, AND IT REFRAMES THE BANK BLOCK. GREP EVIDENCE BEFORE THE FIX: zero hits in assumptions.json for '15% credit', 'credit growth target', 'quota removal', 'abolish' or 'room tin dung' as a POLICY topic. The routine's lane 1 tracks 'credit-quota policy and quota-removal pilot' and the file has been running the lane without recording it. WHAT IS NOW ON FILE. (1) SBV'S 2026 SYSTEM CREDIT GROWTH TARGET IS ~15%, against 2025 ACTUAL of 19%. (2) ROOM IS ALLOCATED PER BANK ON 2024 SCORING AND RANKING x A COMMON COEFFICIENT, with priority for institutions in system restructuring. (3) SBV GUIDANCE PACES ROUGHLY 25% OF THE YEAR'S CREDIT GROWTH INTO EACH QUARTER - a within-year constraint this file has never held. (4) THE MECHANISM IS BEING PHASED OUT GRADUALLY, NOT ABOLISHED; the PM has instructed SBV to STUDY abolition, and SBV must adjust room to fit a GDP growth target of 8.3-8.5%. (5) SBV IS TIGHTENING OVERSIGHT OF PROPERTY CREDIT GROWTH IN 2026 - which touches KDH at 20.3% of the book and is the subject of one of the analyst questions on file. THE LIKE-FOR-LIKE COMPARISON AT END-JUNE, WHICH IS THE ONLY DATE ALL THREE SHARE. System +7.73%. MBB +13.2% = 1.71x system. TCB +10.39% = 1.34x system. AGAINST A 15% FULL-YEAR SYSTEM TARGET, SIX MONTHS IN: MBB HAS USED 88.0% OF IT, TCB 69.3%, THE SYSTEM ITSELF 51.5%. WHAT THIS DOES NOT LICENSE, AND IT IS THE WHOLE DISCIPLINE OF THE ENTRY. 15% IS A SYSTEM TARGET. INDIVIDUAL BANKS RECEIVE INDIVIDUAL ROOM, AND A HIGH-RATED BANK'S ROOM CAN EXCEED 15%. SO 'MBB IS AT 88% OF 15%' DOES NOT MEAN MBB HAS 1.8pp LEFT FOR H2. SAYING SO WOULD BE THE SYSTEM-VERSUS-BANK MEASURE SUBSTITUTION THIS FILE HAS CATALOGUED FIVE TIMES. IT IS NOT SAID. THE ACTUAL FINDING IS A NAMED GAP: THIS FILE HAS NO RECORD OF ANY INDIVIDUAL BANK'S 2026 ROOM, AND THAT IS THE NUMBER THAT WOULD MAKE MBB'S H2 BRANCHES DERIVABLE INSTEAD OF TYPED IN. The DECISION-BRIEF already says MBB has 'STILL NO DRIVER MODEL ... branches typed in, derived from nothing and recomputed by nothing', and that fy26e_npat 28,000/30,500/33,000 REQUIRES HUMAN RE-DERIVATION. A per-bank room number is the missing input for that re-derivation, and it is CHEAP - one disclosure, not a model. THE PACING GUIDANCE READ AGAINST MBB'S OWN PROFILE, STATED CONDITIONALLY. MBB ran +3.3% at end-March, ~10% at end-May, +13.2% at end-June. IF its full-year growth were 15%, Q1's 3.3pp is 22% of it and Q2's 9.9pp is 66% - so Q2 ALONE CONSUMED ROUGHLY TWO AND A HALF QUARTERS OF A 25%-PER-QUARTER PACING ALLOWANCE. THE 'IF' IS LOAD-BEARING and is not dropped: MBB's own full-year figure is not established. NOTHING MODELLED. NO CONFIDENCE MOVED. fy26e_npat UNTOUCHED (charter section 4).

_peer_reads._BANK_Q2_PEERS_POINT_DOWN_2026_07_29: PEER PRINTS LANDED AND THEY GO THE OTHER WAY FROM CONSENSUS, one day before MBB files and calibration forecast #4 resolves. ACB Q2/2026: NPAT 4,292bn, DOWN 12.06% YoY; PBT 5,366bn, down 12%. But NET INTEREST INCOME was 7,784bn, UP 16.5% YoY, and customer loans grew 8.6% to 745,759bn. THE ENTIRE MISS IS PROVISIONING - ACB sharply increased credit-risk provisions. VIB Q2 profit 1,905.42bn, DOWN 8.24%. Saigonbank posted a LOSS; VietABank down double digits. Sector-level: Q2 NPAT for covered banks forecast +15% YoY and H1 +16%, but PROVISIONING EXPENSE forecast +19% YoY on existing NPL pressure. WHY THIS MATTERS TOMORROW. MBB's Q2 PBT estimate on file is 8,812bn, +18% YoY. ACB printed -12% and VIB -8.24%. The peers with actual numbers are running well below what the sector forecast implies, and the mechanism is specific and testable: TOP LINE IS FINE, CREDIT COST IS THE SWING. MBB's Q1 NPL was 1.42%. If the same pattern holds, the 8,812bn estimate is optimistic. NOT A FORECAST CHANGE AND NOT A CONFIDENCE CHANGE. This is information about ACB and VIB, not about MBB, and charter s2 does not permit peer results to move a held name's confidence. It is recorded because calibration forecast #4 resolves within 24 hours and this is the best available leading indicator - registering it now means the read is not constructed after the print. AND IT QUALIFIES THIS AFTERNOON'S TT25 CONCLUSION. At 17:53 Circular 25/2026 was logged as easing the FUNDING constraint on credit growth, which it does. These prints say the constraint actually binding on bank PROFIT right now is CREDIT COST, not funding. Both can be true - more room to lend does not make the lending safer - but the TT25 note read as unambiguously supportive and it should not have. More capacity to grow into a rising provisioning cycle is not the same as more profit. Recorded as a correction of emphasis, not of fact.
_peer_reads._VIB_PROVISIONING_DOUBLED_AND_MBB_STILL_: SHARPENS THIS MORNING'S READ-ACROSS FINDING RATHER THAN OVERTURNING IT. VIB's Q2/2026 credit-risk provisioning ROSE 101.6% to 1,280bn - more than doubled - against PBT -8.24%. So the sector provisioning cycle inferred from ACB and VIB WAS REAL AT THOSE BANKS; the mechanism existed and was correctly identified. WHAT FAILED WAS THE TRANSMISSION, not the observation: MBB printed Q2 PBT +40% with net interest income +36.55% and NPL coverage RISING to 93.63% in the same quarter. Also filed this week: BaoViet Bank Q2 profit -50% on provisioning, and VietABank Q2 provisioning up ~19x off a tiny base. THE CORRECTED LESSON IS NARROWER AND MORE USEFUL than 'peer read-across is unreliable'. Several Vietnamese banks did provision heavily in Q2/2026. MBB did not visibly join them. A read-across is a claim that a shared driver reaches a specific book, and the banks it reached (ACB, VIB, BaoViet, VietABank) versus the one it did not (MBB) is itself the question worth asking - MBB's own Q1 provisioning was +15.7% against PBT +14.8%, which was the bank-specific evidence that contradicted the inference and was correctly acted on before the print. STILL UNKNOWN AND STILL THE GAP: MBB's H1 provisioning figure. A second search this sweep again returned only the Q1 number (3,454.8bn, +15.7%), explicitly labelled Q1 - which independently re-confirms this morning's call that the figure circulating in Q2-context coverage was the Q1 one.
_peer_reads._VPS_IPO_TERMS_ARE_A_LIVE_COMPARABLE_FOR: VPS APPEARS IN THIS FILE AS A COMPETITOR AND ITS IPO TERMS DO NOT. Now recorded: ticker VCK, listing sought on HOSE, minimum offer price 60,000/share for up to 202.31m shares, implying a valuation of about US$3.4bn and charter capital rising above 16,400bn. Book-built through VPS plus SSI, MBS, FPTS, KIS, SHS, DNSE and OCBS. The minimum price was RAISED from 22,457 to 60,000 - a 2.67x increase in the ask. Tier T5. WHY IT TOUCHES A HOLDING. The TCX case in this file rests on an explicit statement that THE RISK IS THE MULTIPLE, NOT THE EARNINGS - 2.49x P/B, the priciest in the book. There is currently no fresh public comparable for a large Vietnamese broker. A VPS LISTING WOULD CREATE ONE. At FX 26,300, US$3.4bn is ~89,420bn, which is ABOUT 9% ABOVE TCX'S IMPLIED MARKET CAP OF ~82,215bn (pe_ttm 20.3 x npat_ttm 4,050) - and VPS's margin book is 31,300bn against TCBS's 51,500bn, so VPS is asking to be valued ABOVE TCX ON A MARGIN BOOK 39% SMALLER. Different mix (VPS leads RETAIL BROKERAGE share, TCBS leads MARGIN), so this is a comparable to watch, not an arbitrage. P/B DELIBERATELY NOT COMPUTED. Charter capital is PAR VALUE, not equity, and at 60,000 on 10,000 par most of the ~12,139bn raised would be share premium, so post-money equity is well above 16,400bn by an amount this file does not know. Computing a P/B from charter capital would be exactly the measure error charter s3 check 3 exists to stop. AND THE TERMS MAY BE STALE - THIS IS THE PART THAT NEEDS SAYING. The 60,000 minimum was announced in OCTOBER 2025 for an offering window of Q4/2025 to Q1/2026. THAT WINDOW HAS PASSED. As recently as JUNE 2026 a VPS executive was on the record that choosing a valuation 'that satisfies all parties is not easy', which is a public admission that pricing was still contested eight months after the number was published. So the terms are recorded as ANNOUNCED, with the slippage flagged, not as current market truth. WHAT TO WATCH IS THE DIRECTION IT EVENTUALLY PRINTS: a successful listing near US$3.4bn supports TCX's multiple; a repricing down, or further slippage, is a negative read on the whole cluster - which is 19.5% of this book on a look-through basis, not the 11.4% stated. Nothing modelled, no confidence moved (T5, charter s2).
_peer_reads._A_PEER_FOUNDING_FAMILY_BOUGHT_IN_THE_SA: A CHECK ON WHETHER KDH'S INSIDER BUY IS NAME-SPECIFIC, RUN BECAUSE THE MBB READ-ACROSS FAILURE ARGUES FOR RUNNING IT IN BOTH DIRECTIONS.
